entry.summary: This is the first study of the robustness of LLM-based proof autoformalization in Lean 4, evaluating models on perturbed informal proofs rather than only idealized curated ones. It introduces global paraphrasing and local perturbations to test faithfulness.

entry.title: PolyKV: Heterogeneous Retention and Allocation for KV Cache Compression

author.name: Chao Fei, Panos Kalnis

entry.summary: PolyKV is a layer-wise KV cache compression framework that routes each transformer layer to a suitable compression policy and assigns non-uniform cache budgets under a fixed total, rather than applying uniform policies. It exploits the differing roles of layers during prefill and decoding for long-context inference.

entry.title: Z-Plane Neural Networks: Bounded Geometric Activation Replaces ReLU and LayerNorm

author.name: Sungwoo Goo, Hwi-yeol Yun, Sangkeun Jung

entry.summary: Z-Plane Neural Networks map hidden states into 2D phasor bundles on a hypersphere and introduce a radial-bounding geometric activation that replaces both ReLU and LayerNorm while preserving direction and orthogonality. Inspired by biological axon frequency modulation.

entry.title: DYNA : Dynamic Episodic Memory Networks for Augmenting Large Language Models with Temporal Knowledge Graphs in Continuous Learning

author.name: Ali Sarabadani, Mahtab Tajvidiyan

entry.summary: DYNA augments a frozen LLM with a temporal knowledge graph (events as nodes, timestamped edges) serving as updatable external memory, retrieving nodes via random walks and centrality at query time. Reduces catastrophic forgetting by ~7% versus fine-tuning and improves temporal ordering over standard RAG on temporal recall tasks.

entry.title: GAS-Leak-LLM: Genetic Algorithm-Based Suffix Optimization for Black-Box LLM Jailbreaking

author.name: Aman Anifer, Vignesh Kumar Kembu, Vishnu M, Antonino Nocera, Vinod P., Amal Murali PK, Akshay S Rajan

entry.summary: GAS-Leak-LLM is a black-box jailbreaking attack using a genetic algorithm to evolve adversarial suffixes that bypass safety constraints without access to model parameters. Demonstrates persistent vulnerability of aligned commercial LLMs.

entry.title: DeepRoot: A KG-Coordinated Multi-Agent System for Therapeutic Reasoning over Historical Medical Texts

author.name: Zijian Carl Ma, Sean J. Wang, Sijbren Kramer, Li Erran Li

entry.summary: Introduces DeepRoot, a knowledge-graph-coordinated multi-agent LLM system for converting historical and traditional medical texts into verifiable drug-discovery leads. Argues that grounding and reasoning are separable axes that can be composed for therapeutic reasoning.

entry.title: From Tokens to Regions: CUDA-Sensitive Instruction Tuning for GPU Kernel Generation

author.name: Wentao Chen, Jiace Zhu, Xing Zhe Chai, Zeng Qu, Qiaoling Xiao, Liucheng Duan, An Zou

entry.summary: Introduces CUDA-sensitive instruction tuning for GPU kernel generation, characterizing CUDA sensitivity through token confidence patterns at both token and region levels. Improves LLM kernel correctness without costly agentic or RL pipelines.

entry.title: Learned Image Compression for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Hyeonjun Kim, Jegwang Ryu, Sangbeom Ha, Junhyeok Lee, Jun-Hyuk Kim, Hyemin Ahn, Jaeho Lee

entry.summary: Introduces SPARC, a learned image compression framework tailored for vision-language-action models that allocates bitrate based on the importance of visual regions for downstream control performance. Targets bandwidth-constrained real-time robotic deployment rather than generic visual fidelity.

entry.title: UXBench: Measuring the Actionability of LLM-Generated UX Critiques

author.name: Wenjie Wang, Yue Huang, Zipeng Ling, Han Bao, Hang hua, Xiaonan Luo, Yu Jiang, Shiyi Du, Yuexing Hao, Xiaomin Li, Yuchen Ma, Dianzhuo Wang, Yanfang Ye, Xiangliang Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces UXBench, a benchmark evaluating whether LLM-generated UX critiques are reliable and actionable, using runnable web fixtures with coverage-gated browser exploration that forces evidence collection. Measures report quality by whether a downstream repair agent can improve the interface.

entry.title: SPRI: SVD-Partitioned Residual Initialization for Data-Constrained MoE Upcycling

author.name: Weiqiao Shan, Ruixiang Mao, Yuang Li, Yuhao Zhang, Yingfeng Luo, Tong Zheng, Chen Xu, Yucheng Qiao, Chunxiang Jin, Yi Yuan, Jingdong Chen, Tong Xiao, Jingbo Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes SPRI, an SVD-partitioned residual initialization method for converting pretrained dense models into sparse Mixture-of-Experts models under data-constrained adaptation. Leverages pretrained weight structure while introducing diversity among routed experts.

entry.title: Infant Spontaneous Movement Noise Improves Exploration in Deep RL

author.name: Francisco M. L\'opez, Markus R. Ernst, Francisco Cruz, Matej Hoffmann, and Jochen Triesch

entry.summary: Inspired by infant spontaneous movement patterns, this work shows that progressively increasing the temporal autocorrelation of exploration noise improves exploration efficiency in deep RL. The schedule mimics the developmental rise in spectral exponent of babies' movements.

entry.title: Deep Q-Learning on H\"older Spaces

author.name: Qian Qi

entry.summary: This paper analyzes the operator-theoretic core of Q-learning in continuous-time stochastic control, showing Bellman updates map inputs into an anisotropic regularity class and motivating a tensor-product DeepONet architecture. It establishes approximation complexity results under Holder-regular coefficients.

entry.title: FusionRS: A Large-Scale RGB-Infrared Remote Sensing Dataset for Dual-Modal Vision-Language Foundation Models

author.name: Jiaju Han, Ben Zhang, Xuemeng Sun, Qike Zhang, Yuxian Dong, Chengyin Hu, Fengyu Zhang, Yiwei Wei, Jiujiang Guo

entry.summary: FusionRS is introduced as the first large-scale RGB-infrared-text dataset for dual-modal vision-language learning in remote sensing, constructed by translating diverse imagery. It enables foundation models that exploit complementary thermal and illumination-invariant infrared cues.

entry.title: Zero-order Parameter-free Optimization for LMO-based Methods: Novel Approach for Efficient Fine-tuning

author.name: Dmitriy Bystrov, Daniil Medyakov, Dmitry Bylinkin, Aleksandr Beznosikov

entry.summary: This paper proposes a zeroth-order parameter-free optimization approach for LMO-based methods to enable memory-efficient LLM fine-tuning without costly task-specific tuning of stepsize and smoothing parameters. It combines parameter-free adaptation with geometry-aware updates.

entry.title: PHINN: Persistent Homology Inspired Neural Network for Rare-Event Time Series Generation

author.name: Emre Yusuf, Ren Takahashi, Jayabrata Bhaduri

entry.summary: PHINN uses topological signatures (Betti number transitions) as conditioning signals in a flow-matching framework to generate rare events in time series, with a persistence-landscape loss for homology consistency. It supports cross-domain meta-learning and a natural-language interface for setting topological targets.

entry.title: HAPI-EP: Towards Hybrid, Adaptive, and Predictive Digital Twins of Cardiac Electrophysiology

author.name: Sumeet Vadhavkar, Xiajun Jiang, Yubo Ye, Maryam Toloubidokhti, Linwei Wang

entry.summary: HAPI-EP builds hybrid, adaptive, predictive digital twins of cardiac electrophysiology by integrating a physics-based gray-box model with data-driven components. It addresses rapid patient-specific adaptation and predictive capability beyond pure reconstruction objectives.

entry.title: Reinforcement Learning for LLM-based Event Forecasting

author.name: Amit Arnold Levy

entry.summary: Uses GRPO reinforcement learning to fine-tune 1.5B-14B LLMs equipped with Wikipedia-revision and news-summary tools to forecast real events beyond their knowledge cutoff. Analyzes scaling of forecasting ability and how judgmental forecasting fits verifiable/unverifiable domain taxonomy under aleatoric uncertainty.

entry.title: Evolutionary Bilevel Reward Shaping for Generalization in Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Ekasit Usaratniwart, Xilin Gao, Marc Ong, Youhei Akimoto

entry.summary: GERS uses bilevel evolutionary reward shaping to improve RL generalization to unseen test environments using only scalar validation feedback, without requiring diverse training environments or full trajectory observability. Targets privacy-preserving or restricted scenarios where domain randomization fails.

entry.title: Filtered ANN as a Phase Transition: When Selectivity-Estimation Error Causes Plan Regret

author.name: Madhulatha Mandarapu, Sandeep Kunkunuru

entry.summary: Models filtered approximate-nearest-neighbor query planning as an argmax over a landscape with phases (pre-filter, post-filter, in-filter) separated by boundaries, showing selectivity-estimation error causes plan regret only near critical boundary regions. Quantifies regret as a wedge whose width and height depend on local estimation error and slope.

entry.title: RepNet: Tackling spectral bias in deep neural networks via parameter reparameterization

author.name: Yong Wang, Tao Zhou, Xuhui Meng

entry.summary: RepNet tackles spectral bias in neural networks for scientific computing by reparameterizing first-layer weights and biases to better fit high-frequency and multiscale functions. It targets ReLU and tanh networks for oscillatory problems.

entry.title: Scalable Pairwise Kernel Learning with Stochastic Vec Trick

author.name: Napsu Karmitsa, Tapio Pahikkala, Antti Airola

entry.summary: SPaiK is a scalable kernel learning method for pairwise prediction tasks using a stochastic generalized vec trick to reduce computation and memory while preserving kernel expressivity. It enables pairwise kernel learning on previously intractable dataset sizes.

entry.title: Learning Topological Representations for Molecular Dynamics

author.name: Dominik Geng, Florian Graf, Martin Uray, Roland Kwitt

entry.summary: This paper studies persistent homology as a general-purpose representation for molecular dynamics and introduces a masked Flood complex tailored to protein inter-residue structure. Vectorized persistence diagrams provide geometry-aware summaries for protein classification tasks.

entry.title: DYNA-PRUNER: Input-Adaptive Data-Model Co-Pruning for Efficient and Scalable Spatio-Temporal Media Prediction

author.name: Fuyan Zhang, Yuqi Li, Yingli Tian, Edmond S. L. Ho

entry.summary: DYNA-PRUNER is an input-adaptive co-pruning framework that jointly prunes redundant data regions and corresponding model computational units using synchronized importance masks. It yields per-sample sparse sub-networks for efficient spatio-temporal media prediction like nowcasting and traffic monitoring.

entry.title: Amortized mean-shift interacting particles

author.name: Ali Siahkoohi

entry.summary: Proposes amortized mean-shift interacting particles for Bayesian inference in inverse problems, replacing costly Monte-Carlo averaging with a small set of signed-weight quadrature nodes. Amortizes the per-observation optimization that reads the posterior score.

entry.title: REFLEX: Reflective Evolution from LLM Experience

author.name: Pan Wang

entry.summary: Presents REFLEX, a train-free evolutionary framework for discovering interpretable programmatic policies that structurally decouples visual diagnosis (a vision-enabled Critic) from code generation. Aims to make mutation rationales auditable and retain algorithmic insights across runs.

entry.title: MultiMolecule: a modular ecosystem for biomolecular sequence-model workflows

author.name: Zhiyuan Chen

entry.summary: Presents MultiMolecule, an open-source Python ecosystem that converts heterogeneous RNA, DNA, and protein sequence-model releases into complete, source-checked implementations with shared loading, workflow, and prediction interfaces. Reports 53 model-family implementations, 112 checkpoints, and 16 curated datasets.

entry.title: The Algebra of Units: From Buckingham's Pi-grec Theorem to Latent-Variable Learning

author.name: Mauro Valorani

entry.summary: Shows that dimensionless groups from Buckingham's Pi theorem can be automatically discovered from data without prior physics knowledge, using the observation that log-transformed measurements under different scalings lie on a low-dimensional manifold. Connects dimensional analysis to latent-variable learning.

entry.title: Decoupling Inference from State Updates in Low-Latency Feature Engines via Probabilistic Thinning

author.name: Augusto Peres, Iker Perez, Pedro Valdeira, Guilherme Jardim, Ana Sofia Gomes, Hugo Ferreira, Pedro Bizarro

entry.summary: Decouples inference from durable state persistence in streaming ML feature engines via probabilistic thinning, where every event is scored but durable state updates are selectively triggered only by informative events. Reduces latency and contention from high-frequency read-modify-write operations without requiring cross-worker coordination.

entry.title: CoCoGEC: Counterfactual Generation for Robust Grammatical Error Correction

author.name: Qianyu Wang, Xiaoman Wang, Yuanyuan Liang, Xinyuan Li, Yunshi Lan

entry.summary: CoCoGEC is a counterfactual generation framework for grammatical error correction that alters error-irrelevant contexts to improve robustness under perturbation. It generates intra- and inter-sentence counterfactuals preserving error patterns.

entry.title: Evaluating and Preserving Lexical Stress in English-to-Chinese Speech-to-Speech Translation

author.name: Yuchen Song, Xi Chen, Mingze Li, Satoshi Nakamura

entry.summary: Investigates cross-lingual transfer of lexical stress in English-to-Chinese speech-to-speech translation, constructing a stress-annotated Chinese dataset and an XLS-R Mandarin stress detector. It fine-tunes CosyVoice3 for a stress-aware S2ST system.

entry.title: Surpassing Scale by Efficiency: A Compact 135M Parameter Foundational LLM Natively Adapted for the Bangla Language

author.name: Rabindra Nath Nandi

entry.summary: Presents bangla-smollm-135m, a compact 135M-parameter decoder-only model adapted for Bangla using a deterministic token-merging strategy between TituLLMs and SmolLM2-135M to avoid script fragmentation. It targets efficient edge and mobile deployment for low-resource scripts.

entry.title: The BD-LSC Dataset: Facilitating the Benchmarking of Models for Lexical Semantic Change Detection in Slang and Standard Usage

author.name: Afnan Aloraini, Viktor Schlegel, Goran Nenadic, Riza Batista-Navarro

entry.summary: Introduces the BD-LSC dataset capturing bi-directional lexical semantic change (sense gain, loss, and stability) across three time periods, plus a SlangTrack word sense resource. It targets words with both slang and standard meanings underserved by prior benchmarks.

entry.title: Revisiting the Systematicity in Negation in the Era of In-Context Learning

author.name: Hitomi Yanaka, Taisei Yamamoto

entry.summary: This paper revisits LLM handling of negation through behavioral and representational systematicity, using in-context learning and function vectors. It finds LLMs partially recognize negation scope but fail at perfect performance, with difficulty varying by output format.

entry.title: Style-CCL: Content-Preserving Style Transfer via Curriculum Continual Learning

author.name: Shiwen Zhang, Haoyuan Wang, Xianghao Zang, Haibin Huang, Chi Zhang, Xuelong Li

entry.summary: Style-CCL is a multi-stage curriculum continual learning framework for content-preserving style transfer with Diffusion Transformers, training from semantic to texture styles. It uses a dual-branch Style-Content DiT with separate ROPE embeddings and causal masking to decouple style and content.

entry.title: Vision-Encoder Behavioral Fingerprints of Image-to-Image Generative Models: A Training-Paradigm-Driven Taxonomy of Six Commercial APIs

author.name: Hunter Hill

entry.summary: This work fingerprints six commercial image-to-image APIs using sub-JND adversarial perturbations scored by DINOv2 token distances, partitioning systems into two behavioral bands by training paradigm. Edit-trained models cluster separately from sampling-time-adapted text-to-image base models.

entry.title: Texture-Shape Bias Balancing for Robust Synthetic-to-Real Semantic Segmentation in Automotive NIR Imagery

author.name: Felix Stillger, Ben Hamscher, Lukas Hahn, Annika M\"utze, Tobias Meisen, Kira Maag

entry.summary: This study is the first systematic investigation of synthetic-to-real domain adaptation for semantic segmentation in automotive near-infrared imagery, proposing a generative augmentation framework that balances texture and shape bias. It addresses the scarcity of annotated real NIR data.

entry.title: Adaptive Inference-Time Scaling via Early-Step Latent Verification for Image Editing

author.name: Yue Yu, Yang Jiao, Jiayu Wang, Qi Dai, Jingjing Chen

entry.summary: This paper addresses online zero-shot learning with CLIP under label distribution shift, where sequential test samples are predicted without updating model parameters. It accounts for the mismatch between test label distribution and CLIP's training domain that prior online adaptation methods neglect.

entry.title: SPARK: Spatial Policy-driven Adaptive Reinforcement learning for Knowledge distillation

author.name: Mohamed Jismy Aashik Rasool, Shabir Ahmad, Gisong Oh, Teag Kuen Whangbo

entry.summary: SPARK is a knowledge distillation framework for low-bit quantized image restoration networks that uses a lightweight reinforcement learning policy to adaptively allocate distillation effort across spatial regions. It targets high-frequency regions like edges and textures degraded by quantization rounding noise.

entry.title: MamBOA: State-Space Architecture for Video Recognition

author.name: Mustafa Bora \c{C}elik

entry.summary: MamBOA is a backbone-agnostic temporal framework for fine-grained action recognition that recasts selective state-space recurrence (S6) as a native motion synthesizer via an interleaved scan structure. It interleaves consecutive features into an alternating sequence to model motion.

entry.title: Unlocking Diffusion Hierarchies: Adaptive Timestep Selection for Zero-Shot Segmentation

author.name: Ramin Nakhli, Mahesh Ramachandran, Luca Ballan

entry.summary: Improves zero-shot segmentation from diffusion models by fusing high-resolution attention maps with U-Net encoder features and adaptively selecting timesteps based on hierarchical semantic progression in the denoising process. Overcomes resolution-context tradeoffs and static-timestep reliance.

entry.title: NeRD: Neuro-Symbolic Rule Distillation for Efficient Ontology-Grounded Chain-of-Thought in Medical Image Diagnosis

author.name: Hongxi Yang, Yiwen Jiang, Siyuan Yan, Jamie Chow, Eunis Li, Charlotte Poon, Stephanie Fong, Xiangyu Zhao, Deval Mehta, Yasmeen George, Zongyuan Ge

entry.summary: NeRD is a neuro-symbolic rule distillation framework producing efficient, ontology-grounded reasoning chains for interpretable medical image diagnosis without manually crafting rules or scoring all predefined concepts. Demonstrated on skin disease datasets.

entry.title: 3D Consistency Optimization for Self-Supervised Monocular Video Depth Estimation

author.name: Yuanye Liu, Ke Zhang, Junzhe Jiang, Li Zhang, Vishal Patel, Xiahai Zhuang

entry.summary: Recasts self-supervised monocular video depth estimation as unconstrained multi-view 3D reconstruction, leveraging 3D foundation model priors and a 3D consistency optimization framework to reduce cross-frame drift. Targets endoscopic navigation.

entry.title: Object Tokens as a Bridge Between Segmentation and Visual Question Answering in Robotic Surgery

author.name: Yiping Li, Ronald de Jong, Romy van Jaarsveld, Franco Badaloni, Gino Kuiper, Jelle Ruurda, Josien Pluim, Marcel Breeuwer

entry.summary: Proposes object tokens as a bridge enabling joint pixel-level segmentation and visual question answering in robotic surgery within a single VLM framework, providing finer spatial grounding than bounding boxes. Targets surgical training and intraoperative decision support.

entry.title: CogCanvas: A Benchmark for Evaluating Multi-Subject Reference-Based Image Generation

author.name: Long-Bao Nguyen, Quang-Khai Tran, Tam V. Nguyen, Minh-Triet Tran, Trung-Nghia Le

entry.summary: CogCanvas is a benchmark for multi-subject reference-based image generation that jointly evaluates multi-identity composition, human-object interaction, background grounding, and spatial plausibility, with ~2000 reference images and 1361 compositional prompts. Fills a gap left by single-axis benchmarks.

entry.title: HadBalance: A Plug-and-Play Unified Global Geometric Prior Framework for Generalizable Biomedical Segmentation

author.name: Zhuangzhi Gao, Feixiang Zhou, He Zhao, Wenhan Chen, Ruiyu Luo, Xin Wang, Hongyi Qin, Zhongli Wu, Yanda Meng, Yitian Zhao, Alena Shantsila, Gregory Y. H. Lip, Eduard Shantsila, Yalin Zheng

entry.summary: HadBalance is a plug-and-play framework deriving Hadwiger shape priors to inject a unified global near-convex geometric prior into biomedical segmentation, generalizing across organs and modalities. Aims to improve structural consistency beyond task-specific geometric cues.

entry.title: LOCUS: Local Visual Cue Search for Enhancing Fine-Grained Perception in Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Zhou Tao, Fang Zhang, Zewen Ding, Shida Wang, Xiaokun Sun, YongXiang Hua, Haoyu Cao, Linli Xu

entry.summary: LOCUS is a training framework that teaches multimodal LLMs to internalize local-evidence search via a verifiable proxy task, using a local crop and IoU-based reward to recover its spatial support. It addresses visual context rot where decisive details exist but are not reliably selected, while keeping the standard inference interface unchanged.

entry.title: MeshLoom: Feed-Forward Non-Rigid Registration of Mesh Sequences

author.name: Jianqi Chen, Jiraphon Yenphraphai, Xiangjun Tang, Sergey Tulyakov, Chaoyang Wang, Peter Wonka, Rameen Abdal

entry.summary: MeshLoom is a feed-forward network that directly reconstructs vertex deformations across mesh sequences for non-rigid registration, registering multiple meshes within seconds. It uses a topology-aware point representation encoding the anchor mesh's topology to disambiguate points and strengthen geometric understanding.

entry.title: Neural dynamical systems on ferroelectric compute-in-memory for real-time forecasting

author.name: Keshava Katti, Adithya Selvakumar, Pratik Chaudhari, Deep Jariwala

entry.summary: FerroNDS is a neuromorphic system that maps neural dynamical systems onto ferroelectric compute-in-memory hardware using analog integrator and oscillator primitives built from multi-bit ferrodiodes. A 128-neuron instance computes short-time Fourier transforms and forecasts 500ms horizons for periodic, quasi-periodic, and chaotic signals.

entry.title: ReactSim-Bench: Benchmarking Reactive Behavior World Model Simulation in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Zhiyuan Zhang, Yanlun Peng, Jianing Zhang, Xianda Guo, Zehan Huang, Haoran Liu, Qifeng Li, Shaofeng Zhang, Xiaosong Jia, Junchi Yan

entry.summary: ReactSim-Bench is a benchmark that specifically measures the reactive capability of behavior world-model simulators in autonomous driving by decoupling control of the AV from surrounding agents. This fills a gap where existing benchmarks conflate realism metrics with genuine reactivity.

entry.title: Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA: From Vision-Language-Action Models to a Real-World Robot Learning Stack

author.name: He Zhang, Lingzhu Xiang, Haitao Lin, Zeyu Huang, Minghui Wang, Dingyan Zhong, Yubo Dong, Yihao Wu, Yongming Rao, Dongsheng Zhang, Wanjia He, Ling Chen, Kai Huang, Jiahao Chen, Sichang Su, Xumin Yu, Ziyi Wang, Chengwei Zhu, Xiao Teng, Yuchun Guo, Yufeng Zhang, Yuandong Liu, Rui Wang, Zisheng Lu, Han Hu, Zhengyou Zhang

entry.summary: Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA (HyVLA-0.5) is a technical report presenting a full robot-learning stack spanning data collection, model design, pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, RL post-training, and real-world deployment. It represents a large team effort to build an end-to-end VLA system.

entry.title: Sensitivity Shaping for Latent Modeling

author.name: Hongzhan Yu, Chenghao Li, Ruipeng Zhang, Henrik Christensen, Sicun Gao

entry.summary: Proposes support-conditioned control-sensitivity regularization for learned latent dynamics models, addressing the failure where dynamics become locally insensitive to critical actions and suppress out-of-distribution signals. This improves reliable OOD detection for safe model-based planning.

entry.title: EgoGuide: Egocentric Guidance for Efficient Robot-Free Demonstration Collection and Learning

author.name: Yue Xu, Mingtao Nie, Tianle Li, Hong Li, Yibo Luo, Siyuan Huang, Yong-Lu Li

entry.summary: EgoGuide is a robot-free demonstration collection interface recording synchronized wrist and egocentric/head observations with online data-quality guidance, plus a gated egocentric residual policy that uses head context to correct ambiguous wrist views. It improves data efficiency for scalable robot learning.

entry.title: RT-VLA: Real-Time Vision-Language-Action Models via Knowledge Distillation

author.name: Xiangyu Huang, Zhenlin Hua, Han Zhou, Shounak Sural, Ragunathan Rajkumar

entry.summary: RT-VLA distills the driving and reasoning capabilities of the SimLingo VLA into a compact student via multi-level supervised distillation, preserving language-based reasoning and post-hoc explanation while reducing inference latency for real-time deployment. It targets the latency bottleneck of large VLA backbones in autonomous driving.

entry.title: In open RLVR, “improvement” depends on the instrument — a small GRPO testbed separating what training optimizes, measures, and teaches

author.name: JulesRoussel01

entry.summary: Presents a small GRPO testbed on Qwen2.5-0.5B/GSM8K demonstrating that in open RLVR the same run can appear as success, failure, or reversal depending on the measurement instrument (reward channel, extractor, decoding regime). It makes measurement-conflation failures cheap to reproduce and inspect.

entry.title: Fusion is not one-size-fits-all: Cross-Modal Representation Alignment for Time-to-Event Modeling

author.name: Zhemin Zhang, Weijie Chen, David Le, Amara Tariq, Alex Wallace, Matthew Stib, Juan Maria Farina, Chadi Ayoub, Reza Arsanjani, Imon Banerjee

entry.summary: Proposes a foundation-model-driven framework for cross-modal alignment between CT imaging and longitudinal EHR data for time-to-event prediction, comparing four fusion strategies on clinical cohorts. Shows fusion choice should vary by task.

entry.title: Large Language Models as Optimizers: A Survey of Direct vs. Tool-Augmented Approaches and Their Performance Frontiers

author.name: Roko Peran, Luka Hobor, Mihael Kovac, Mario Brcic

entry.summary: Surveys LLMs as optimizers across three paradigms (direct, tool-augmented, and tool-creating optimization) and analyzes their performance frontiers. Provides a structured taxonomy for the LLM-as-optimizer field.

entry.title: Heteroskedastic Signals in Budgeted LLM Verification: Structural Heterogeneity Limits Optimization Gains

author.name: Jinlong Yang

entry.summary: Identifies a failure mode in budgeted LLM verification where uncertainty signal quality is heteroskedastic across cost strata, undermining the assumption that equal scores carry comparable decision value. Characterizes resulting distortions in compute allocation.

entry.title: PAL-Bench: Evidence-Grounded Profile Reconstruction from Longitudinal Personal Albums

author.name: Qiwei Yan, Zhiqiang Yuan, Zexi Jia, Nanxing Hu, Kailin Lyu, Jie Zhou, Jinchao Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces PAL-Bench, a controlled benchmark for reconstructing personal profiles, social graphs, and evidence provenance from longitudinal photo albums while preserving privacy through synthetic latent worlds. Addresses album-scale multimodal reasoning with social identity binding that existing benchmarks fail to test.

entry.title: Tensor-Coord: Algebraic Decomposition of Joint Plan Tensors for Conflict-Free Multi-Agent LLM Planning

author.name: Mudit Rastogi

entry.summary: Tensor-Coord represents multi-agent joint plans as a third-order tensor and uses CP/Tucker decompositions to identify coordination structure and a computable coordination complexity measure. Proves rank conditions necessary and sufficient for plan independence and uses residuals for conflict detection.

entry.title: Symbolic Informalization: Fluent, Productive, Multilingual

author.name: Aarne Ranta

entry.summary: Symbolic informalization (project Informath) reliably converts formal machine-checked mathematics into fluent, multilingual natural language without precision loss, generalizing syntactic sugar into ordinary mathematical language. Explains AI-constructed and autoformalized proofs to humans.

entry.title: ScoutVLA: UAV-Centric Active Perception via a Dual-Expert VLA Model for Open-World Embodied Question Answering

author.name: Wenhao Lu, Zhengqiu Zhu, Xiaofeng Wang, Xiaoran Zhang, Yatai Ji, Yong Zhao, Yue Hu, Yingzhen Nie, Jinlong Zhu, Zheng Zhu

entry.summary: ScoutVLA introduces a vision-language-action model and the FG-EQA benchmark for fine-grained active perception in aerial embodied question answering by UAVs. Inspired by scout-bee waggle dances, it iteratively adjusts viewpoints to verify evidence for answering questions.

entry.title: Separable Neural Architectures as Physical World Models: from Mathematical Theory to Applications

author.name: Reza T Batley, Andrew Kichline, Sourav Saha

entry.summary: Separable Neural Architecture combines neural approximation with tensor decomposition to represent functions, decoupling localized coordinate atoms from global low-rank interactions for solving PDEs. The variational version provides classical Lax-Milgram guarantees and mitigates the curse of dimensionality.

entry.title: Beyond Correctness: Enhancing Architectural Reasoning in Code LLMs via Scalable Labeling with Agentic Judgment

author.name: Kirill Vasilevski (Justina), Ximing Dong (Justina), Benjamin Rombaut (Justina), Ruochen Deng (Justina), Jiahuei Lin (Justina), Arthur Leung, Dayi Lin, Boyuan Chen, Shaowei Wang, Ahmed E. Hassan

entry.summary: This work introduces an agentic judging pipeline using a strong LLM to scalably label architectural reasoning quality in code, with separate Architecture Complexity and Quality judges. Fine-tuning Qwen3 models on curated instances improves resolved rates on SWE-bench Verified.

entry.title: NEXUS: Neural Energy Fields for Physically Consistent Contact-Rich 3D Object Dynamics

author.name: Qizhen Ying, Guangming Wang, Yangchen Pan, Victor Adrian Prisacariu, Yixiong Jing

entry.summary: NEXUS is a neural energy-field framework for physically consistent contact-rich 3D object dynamics, representing objects as structural graphs with dynamic contact graphs and Hamiltonian-inspired energy/dissipation terms. It composes conservative and non-conservative effects for physics-grounded video generation.

entry.title: StarOR: Synergizing Tree Search and Test-Time Reinforcement Learning for Optimization Modeling

author.name: Jiajun Li, Yu Ding, Shisi Guan, Ran Hou, Wanyuan Wang

entry.summary: StarOR synergizes Monte Carlo tree search with test-time reinforcement learning for hierarchical optimization modeling, addressing brittle one-shot generation and biased fixed-policy rollouts. It enables structural exploration with instance-level computation and better credit assignment for symbolic modeling.

entry.title: Adapting Reinforcement Learning with Chain-of-Thought Supervision for Explainable Detection of Hateful and Propagandistic Memes

author.name: Mohamed Bayan Kmainasi, Mucahid Kutlu, Ali Ezzat Shahroor, Abul Hasnat, Firoj Alam

entry.summary: Proposes a reinforcement learning post-training method using GRPO and task-specific rewards to improve both classification and explanation quality of multimodal LLMs detecting hateful and propagandistic memes across English and Arabic. It addresses an underexplored content-moderation application with explainability focus.

entry.title: Selective Synergistic Learning for Video Object-Centric Learning

author.name: WonJun Moon, Jae-Pil Heo

entry.summary: Proposes selective synergistic learning for video object-centric learning, replacing indiscriminate dense alignment of encoder attention and decoder object maps with selective alignment to avoid propagating each module's weaknesses and reduce quadratic cost.

entry.title: Mutual Distillation of Dual-Foundation Models for Semi-Supervised PET/CT Segmentation

author.name: Fuyou Mao, Beining Wu, Yanfeng Jiang, Bohan Xu, Lixin Lin, Naye Ji, Hao Zhang, Yan Tang

entry.summary: Proposes a mutual distillation framework leveraging both structural (CT) and functional (PET) foundation models as modality-specific teachers for semi-supervised PET/CT organ segmentation with limited labels. Bridges student precision and foundation-model generalization.

entry.title: From Correlation to Causation in Lane Change Prediction for Automated Driving: A Causal Explanation Framework

author.name: Mohamed Manzour, Aditya Kumar, Augusto Luis Ballardini, Miguel \'Angel Sotelo

entry.summary: Presents a causal-inference framework for lane-change prediction combining linguistic feature construction, expert-constrained causal discovery, and causal explanation, moving beyond statistical associations to model causal dependencies among physically related driving variables. Improves interpretability for automated driving.

entry.title: SkillVetBench: LLM-as-Judge for Multi-Dimensional Security Risk Evaluation in Open-Source LLM Agent Skills

author.name: Ismail Hossain, Sai Puppala, Md Jahangir Alam, Tanzim Ahad, Sajedul Talukder

entry.summary: Presents SkillVetBench, a live leaderboard using an LLM-as-judge to assess multi-dimensional security risks in community-contributed LLM agent skills, including instruction-layer and multi-agent attack vectors that code scanners miss. Introduces a five-dimensional agentic risk score.

entry.title: Formalize Once, Edit the Rest: Efficient Lean-Based Answer Selection for Math Reasoning

author.name: Ji Feng, Zhouxing Shi

entry.summary: Proposes BASE, a base-and-edit pipeline that formalizes a single candidate answer into Lean and derives the remaining candidates by editing, reducing the cost of Lean-based answer selection in math reasoning. Targets efficient test-time scaling with verifiable proofs.

entry.title: InvDesMobility: a reliability-gated first-principles feedback framework for closed-loop materials discovery

author.name: Wen-Kao Li, Ze-Feng Gao, Peng-Jie Guo, Wei Ji, Zhong-Yi Lu

entry.summary: Presents InvDesMobility, a reliability-gated closed-loop framework for inverse materials design that integrates multi-agent automated DFT, evidence stratification, and generative structure proposal for carrier mobility. Admits expensive first-principles results as feedback only when evidence is sufficient.

entry.title: Who Should Lead Decoding Now? Tracking Reliable Trajectories for Ensembling Masked Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Heecheol Yun, Joonhyung Park, Joowon Kim, Eunho Yang

entry.summary: Studies the decoding dynamics of masked diffusion language models and proposes TIE, a trajectory-based iterative ensembling framework that identifies reliable decoding trajectories and relays promising intermediate states between models. Aims to fuse knowledge across diverse MDLMs.

entry.title: Communication-Efficient Verifiable Attention for LLM Inference

author.name: Ziqun Chen, Ming Wu, Michael Heinrich, Jason Zeng, Huiying Lan, Tianwei Zhang, Rui Tan

entry.summary: Presents VeriAttn, a communication-efficient verifiable attention scheme offloading both linear and non-linear attention computations to an untrusted GPU while a trusted execution environment performs verification. Reduces the TEE computation and communication overhead of applying TSDP to transformers.

entry.title: What Should a Streaming Video Model Remember?

author.name: Haonan Ge, Yiwei Wang, Hang Wu, Yujun Cai

entry.summary: Formulates streaming video memory as budgeted online latent evidence allocation and proposes SelectStream, which keeps the current observation directly visible to a frozen VLM while selectively allocating limited memory. Argues the key challenge is selective allocation rather than whether to use memory.

entry.title: Direction-Conditioned Policies via Compositional Subgoal Scoring for Online Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Swaminathan S K, Damiya Gondha, Theyanesh Eswaramoorthy Rajahkrishnan, Aritra Hazra

entry.summary: Direction-Conditioned Policies reformulate goal-conditioned RL using HJB theory, conditioning the actor on a learned direction and magnitude toward subgoals rather than raw goal coordinates. This improves performance when goals lie far from the data distribution.

entry.title: A Perception vs. Distortion Perspective on Score-Based Generative Channel Estimation

author.name: Marco Skocaj, Lukas Eller, Mate Boban

entry.summary: This paper provides a theoretically grounded analysis of when score-based generative channel estimation outperforms discriminative learning, framed through the perception-distortion tradeoff. It identifies conditions where score matching excels in this wireless inverse problem.

entry.title: Federated Medical Image Segmentation under Real-World Label Noise: A Benchmark Suite for Noisy Label Learning Method Selection

author.name: Markus Bujotzek, Dimitrios Bounias, Stefan Denner, Ralf Floca, Maximilian Fischer, Peter Neher, Klaus Maier-Hein

entry.summary: This work introduces a benchmark suite for federated medical image segmentation under realistic label noise, combining diverse real-world noisy datasets and deployment-relevant client-noise scenarios. It enables systematic evaluation and informed selection of federated noisy-label learning methods.

entry.title: HAMON: Passive Optical Sequence Mixing for Long-Horizon Forecasting

author.name: Alper Y{\i}ld{\i}r{\i}m

entry.summary: HAMON proposes a passive diffractive optical forecasting core where historical time-series values are encoded onto an optical aperture and trainable phase masks shape the forecast through free-space diffraction. It explores whether low-complexity forecasting operators need digital implementation at all.

entry.title: Towards a Unified Generative Model for Scarce Time Series with Domain Experts

author.name: Zihao Yao, Qi Zheng, Jiankai Zuo, Yaying Zhang

entry.summary: TimeMoDE combines Diffusion Transformers with Mixture-of-Experts for time series generation under data scarcity, pretraining on multi-domain data and using domain prompts for adaptation. It aims to extract domain-agnostic temporal representations that transfer to low-data settings.

entry.title: The Data Manifold under the Microscope

author.name: Marios Koulakis, Constantin Seibold

entry.summary: Introduces a benchmarking framework for studying data-manifold geometry by extending dSprites and COIL-20 with controlled transformation dimensions and dense sampling. Aims to bridge the theory-practice gap in generalization bounds that rely on geometric regularity assumptions.

entry.title: pFedUL: Layer-Aware Federated Unlearning for Personalized Federated Learning

author.name: Zhuodong Liu, Xiangyu Li, Zhihao Zhang

entry.summary: pFedUL is a layer-aware federated unlearning method designed for personalized federated learning paradigms (FedPer, FedRep, Ditto, FedBN) that decompose models into shared and client-specific layers. It formalizes the tension between unlearning shared versus personalized layers under GDPR-style requirements.

entry.title: Tail-Shape Estimation in LLM Evaluation Is Fragile: A Protocol for Diagnosing False Positives

author.name: Luca Zhou

entry.summary: This paper critiques tail-aware metrics in LLM evaluation, arguing that extreme-value-theory tail-index estimates add little beyond mean and tail-magnitude statistics. It contributes a pre-registered protocol for diagnosing false positives in tail-shape claims.

entry.title: A Validated LBM Dataset and Pipeline for Surrogate Modeling of Turbulent 3D Obstructed Channel Flows

author.name: Lukas Schr\"oder, Shubham Kavane, Harald K\"ostler

entry.summary: This work presents a validated lattice Boltzmann dataset and pipeline for surrogate modeling of 3D turbulent obstructed channel flows, rigorously verified against experimental benchmarks. It enables standardized comparison of neural operators on turbulent flow tasks.

entry.title: Analytic Torsion and Spectral Gap Capture Persistent-Laplacian Performance

author.name: Jernej Grlj, Aaron D. Lauda

entry.summary: This paper distills the persistent Laplacian into three interpretable invariants (Betti numbers, spectral gap, analytic torsion) for compact spectral representations in learning tasks. The reduced features match or exceed the full spectrum while cutting computational overhead.

entry.title: Multiscale Hypersonic Boundary Layer Reconstruction via Spectral Binning and Subdomain-wise Conditional Diffusion

author.name: Hojin Kim, Dibyajyoti Chakraborty, Takahiko Toki, Carlo Scalo, Romit Maulik

entry.summary: This paper proposes a multiscale probabilistic reconstruction framework for hypersonic Couette flow using conditional diffusion models over overlapping wall-normal subdomains. It introduces a bounded binned spectral approach and soft-overlap inpainting to improve spectral fidelity in reconstructions.

entry.title: Coercivity and Local Convergence of Physical Learning in Linear Circuits

author.name: Joshua A. McGinnis, Xinbo Li, Yoichiro Mori

entry.summary: Provides the first local convergence analysis of three physical learning methods (Equilibrium Propagation, Coupled Learning, and a new Adjoint Coupled Learning) for linear circuits in the small-nudging limit. Identifies a coercivity condition guaranteeing convergence.

entry.title: Lesion-DDPM: Lesion-Enhanced 3D Diffusion for MS MRI Synthesis

author.name: Weidong Zhang, Yongchan Jung, Shafayat Mowla Anik, Furen Xiao, Vasudevan Janarthanan, Enkhzaya Chuluunbaatar, Byeong Kil Lee, Jeeho Ryoo

entry.summary: Introduces Lesion-DDPM, a 3D conditional diffusion framework for synthesizing FLAIR MRI scans in multiple sclerosis with lesion-aware anatomical mask injection and lesion-weighted reconstruction loss. Targets data scarcity for neuroimaging machine learning models.

entry.title: Stochastic trace estimation with tensor train random vectors

author.name: Zvonimir Bujanovi\'c, Daniel Kressner, Hrvoje Oli\'c

entry.summary: Studies Gaussian random tensor-train vectors as a structured alternative for stochastic trace estimation in tensor-structured settings, showing they recover dimension-independent guarantees with appropriate tensor-train rank. Includes a median-of-means variant.

entry.title: Acoustic Prompting via Stage-wise Modulation for Few-Shot Learning in Audio Language Models

author.name: Hyebin Cho, Jaehyuk Jang, Changick Kim, Joon Son Chung

entry.summary: Introduces audio-side learnable prompts (in addition to text prompts) for few-shot adaptation of audio-language models, using stage-wise modulation to capture task-specific acoustic features. Demonstrates improvements as a plug-and-play module across 11 datasets.

entry.title: Learning the Geometry of Data: A Mathematical Review of Shape Space Analysis

author.name: Gary P. T. Choi, Khanh Dao Duc, Shira Faigenbaum-Golovin, Karen Habermann, Emmanuel Hartman, Christoph von Tycowicz, Chi Zhang, Wenjun Zhao, Felix Zhou

entry.summary: A mathematical review synthesizing shape space analysis for learning the geometry of data, covering nonlinear geometric structure across biology, medicine, and computer vision. It surveys methods that traditional ML overlooks.

entry.title: AmchiBias: Measuring Stereotypical Bias in Goan Identity Groups with a Minimal Pair Dataset in English and Konkani

author.name: Michelle Barbosa, Sebastian Pad\'o, Franziska Weeber

entry.summary: AmchiBias is the first benchmark measuring socio-cultural stereotypical bias at the subnational level for Goa, with 313 minimal pairs across eight dimensions in English and Konkani. It finds near-chance results in Konkani revealing multilingual model incompetence.

entry.title: Interactor: Agentic RL oriented Iterative Creation for Ad Description Generation in Sponsored Search

author.name: Penghui Wei, Jiayu Wu, Chao Ye, Zhi Guo, Shuanglong Li, Lin Liu

entry.summary: Interactor is a multi-turn iterative creation framework optimized with agentic RL for generating informative ad descriptions in sponsored search, using multiple generative reward models in a customized environment. It incorporates world knowledge and fine-grained selling points.

entry.title: Does Traversal Order Matter? A Systematic Study of Tree Traversal Methods in Transformer Grammars

author.name: Zongru Liu, Pengyu Ji, Pengcheng Wang, Kewei Tu

entry.summary: This paper systematically studies how tree traversal order (depth-first, breadth-first, and a new production-rule traversal) affects Transformer Grammars for syntax-aware language modeling. It expands a design space previously limited to depth-first linearization.

entry.title: Disagreement-Based Cross-Model Routing for Implicit Video Question Answering

author.name: Durga Sandeep Saluru

entry.summary: This paper proposes disagreement-based cross-model routing for implicit video QA, a training-free inference procedure that triple-samples a video LLM (Gemini 3.1 Pro) and routes hard questions where self-consistency fails. It addresses correlated errors that majority voting cannot fix.

entry.title: CoMNeT: A MedNeXt-CorrDiff Framework for Volumetric Brain Tumor Segmentation

author.name: Michael L. Evans, MD Fayaz Bin Hossen, MD Shibly Sadique, Walia Farzana, Khan M. Iftekharuddin

entry.summary: CoMNeT combines a MedNeXt 3D convolutional segmentation model with corrective diffusion-based refinement and ensembling for volumetric brain tumor segmentation. It targets improved voxel-level precision for small clinically important regions like enhancing tumor and tumor core.

entry.title: Timestep Rescheduling in Diffusion Inversion

author.name: Shangquan Sun, Ting Gong, Zhirui Liu, Jiamin Wu, Runkai Zhao, Mianxin Liu, Wenqi Ren, Xiaochun Cao

entry.summary: Identifies that diffusion inversion error depends on timestep size in a parabolic manner, with larger errors at small and large timesteps, and proposes a nonuniform timestep rescheduling to improve inversion fidelity. Relevant for image reconstruction and editing tasks.

entry.title: RaLMPH: Reliability-aware Learning for Multi-Pathologist Harmonization in Whole-Slide Image Classification

author.name: Sungrae Hong, Jiwon Jeong, Soeun Cheon, Donghee Han, Sol Lee, Jisu Shin, Kyungeun Kim, Mun Yong Yi

entry.summary: RaLMPH is a multiple-instance-learning framework for whole-slide image classification that reconciles labels from multiple disagreeing pathologists via reliability-aware learning, instead of assuming a single gold label. Addresses clinically realistic inter-annotator variability.

entry.title: SpatialAvatar-0: High-Quality 4D Head Avatar with Multi-Stage Reconstruction

author.name: Yiran Wang, Zeyu Zhang, Yuanming Li, Ziming Wang, Yang Zhao

entry.summary: SpatialAvatar-0 unifies feed-forward and per-subject 3D Gaussian Splatting regimes for high-quality 4D head avatar reconstruction from few portraits, using a shared FLAME-mesh-bound representation. Targets telepresence and AR/VR digital humans.

entry.title: SiGnature: Explicit Motion Diffusion for Stylized Semantic Gesture

author.name: Adi Rosenthal, Tomer Koren, Nadav Shaked, Doron Friedman, Ariel Shamir

entry.summary: SiGnature generates stylized, semantically meaningful co-speech gestures in an explicit joint-rotation space rather than entangled latents, improving rare semantic gestures (iconic shapes, deictic pointing) while preserving speaker style. Addresses the sparsity of semantic gestures.

entry.title: Mind the Gap: Diagnosing Constraint Discovery Failures in Text-in-Image Editing

author.name: Rui Gui

entry.summary: A diagnostic study of constraint discovery failures in text-in-image editing, showing across 461 cases and four MLLMs that models recover only 46% of required secondary edits unguided versus 94% when constraints are explicit. Reveals a gap in deciding which visual dependencies matter under a task.

entry.title: BadWorld: Adversarial Attacks on World Models

author.name: Linghui Shen, Mingyue Cui, Xingyi Yang

entry.summary: BadWorld is a label-free adversarial attack framework for autoregressive visual world models, overcoming the lack of ground-truth future videos and unpredictable user controls. It uses a self-supervised velocity attack on early denoising dynamics plus an action-generalizing formulation.

entry.title: Test-Time Adaptation of Spiking Neural Networks for Intracortical Neural Decoding using Membrane Potential Alignment

author.name: Guangzhi Tang

entry.summary: Membrane Potential Alignment (MPA) is a test-time adaptation method for spiking neural networks that realigns a pretrained intracortical neural decoder to shifted recordings by matching membrane potential distributions via KL divergence. By restricting updates to low-rank weights it adapts fewer than 9% of parameters, matching state-of-the-art while being suitable for implantable hardware.

entry.title: PhysVLA: Towards Physically-Grounded VLA for Embodied Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Namai Chandra, Shriram Damodaran, Lin Wang

entry.summary: PhysVLA is a plug-and-play inference-time framework that wraps any frozen vision-language-action backbone to enforce physical principles like rigid-body dynamics and contact constraints without retraining or weight access. It bridges the physics gap where standard temporal smoothing trades trajectory quality for failures, adding less than 1ms overhead.

entry.title: Universal Manipulation Exoskeleton: Learning Compliant Whole-body Policies with Real-time Torque Feedback

author.name: Litian Liang, Jingxi Xu, Xinda Qi, Yujun Cai, Houzhu Ding, Luqi Wang, Zhixin Sun, Jyh-Herng Chow, Ming Yang, Mark Cutkosky

entry.summary: Presents the Universal Manipulation Exoskeleton (UME), a low-cost upper-limb exoskeleton providing real-time haptic torque feedback while recording whole-arm configurations and joint torques for teleoperation. It enables collection of force/torque data for learning compliant manipulation policies.

entry.title: How Matryoshka Sparse AutoEncoders Recover Feature Hierarchies That Vanilla SAEs Lose

author.name: baimamboukar

entry.summary: A walkthrough and guided replication explaining how Matryoshka Sparse Autoencoders train nested dictionaries simultaneously to organize features hierarchically, mitigating the feature-splitting and feature-absorption problems that plague vanilla SAEs at scale. It is an accessible exposition of mechanistic interpretability research.

entry.title: Can the Safety Tax Be Highly Concentrated?

author.name: ozziegooen

entry.summary: Argues that AI safety's alignment tax could be highly concentrated, applying expensive specialized safety measures only to the under-1% of actions carrying catastrophic risk, making blended overhead small even with enormous per-action multipliers. It reframes the competitiveness objection to compute-heavy safety.

entry.title: CONCORD: Asynchronous Sparse Aggregation for Device-Cloud RAG under Document Isolation

author.name: Xuedong Hu, Zhiqing Tang, Zhi Yao, Tian Wang, Weijia Jia

entry.summary: CONCORD proposes an asynchronous sparse aggregation framework for device-cloud RAG where private documents stay on-device and public knowledge is in the cloud, avoiding raw document exchange. Improves throughput under latency and bandwidth constraints.

entry.title: Your Agent Has a Genome: Sequence-Level Behavioral Analysis and Runtime Governance of LLM-Powered Autonomous Agents

author.name: Sidi Deng

entry.summary: Proposes Base Sequence Analysis, encoding LLM agent runtime behavior into symbolic sequences using a four-letter alphabet (Explore, Execute, Plan, Verify) and applying genomic-style analysis to identify risky patterns from real execution traces. Enables runtime behavioral governance.

entry.title: Overcoming the Impedance Mismatch: A Theoretical Roadmap for Fusing Foundation Models and Knowledge Graphs

author.name: Sahil Rajesh Dhayalkar

entry.summary: Formalizes the impedance mismatch between continuous foundation models and discrete knowledge graphs, arguing that RAG-style lexical bridging is superficial, and proposes a three-tiered taxonomy of neuro-symbolic integration. A theoretical roadmap for fusing the two paradigms.

entry.title: Agentic Framework for Deep Learning workload migration via In-Context Learning

author.name: Qiyue Liang, Steven Ingram, George Vanica, Andi Gavrilescu, Newfel Harrat, Hassan Sipra, Sethuraman Sankaran

entry.summary: Presents an autonomous system combining in-context learning with oracle-driven self-debugging to migrate deep learning models from PyTorch to JAX, using actual execution outputs as ground truth rather than relying on the LLM to deduce math. Automates an error-prone manual task.

entry.title: PH-KAN: Port-Hamiltonian Kolmogorov-Arnold Network

author.name: Achraf El Messaoudi (UMLP, ENSMM, FEMTO-ST), Karim Cherifi (UMLP, ENSMM, FEMTO-ST), Yann Le Gorrec (UMLP, ENSMM, FEMTO-ST), Yongxin Wu (UMLP, ENSMM, FEMTO-ST)

entry.summary: PH-KAN proposes a structure-preserving identification framework for nonlinear port-Hamiltonian systems using Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks instead of MLPs to yield more interpretable learned constitutive components. Combines physics-informed structure preservation with KAN interpretability.

entry.title: AdaMame: A Training Recipe for Adaptive Multilingual Reasoning

author.name: Dayeon Ki, Kevin Duh, Marine Carpuat

entry.summary: AdaMame is a two-stage training recipe for multilingual mathematical reasoning that adaptively aligns reasoning language to query language without sacrificing accuracy, addressing language collapse. It uses multilingual SFT followed by an adaptive RL stage to avoid mid-trace code-switching and excessive tokens.

entry.title: Post-Launch Capability Expansion of Vision-Language Models via Prompting for On-Orbit Spacecraft Inspection

author.name: Nicholas A. Welsh, Lennon J. Shikhman, Monty Nehru Attazs, Seemanthini K. Putane, Van Minh Nguyen, Ryan T. White

entry.summary: Tests whether prompt-driven vision-language models can add new spacecraft inspection capabilities post-launch via natural-language prompts without weight updates, evaluating zero-shot instance segmentation on unseen satellites. Addresses operational constraints of deployed orbital perception.

entry.title: Task-guided cross-subject latent alignment: a multi-encoder-decoder VAE

author.name: Angeliki Papathanasiou, Jascha Achterberg, Thomas E. Nichols, Rui Ponte Costa

entry.summary: Introduces MED-VAE, a multi-encoder-decoder VAE that aligns neural activity across subjects without requiring shared stimuli by anchoring to a pretrained ANN scaffold. Demonstrates superior cross-subject latent alignment on the Natural Scenes Dataset.

entry.title: LLM-Powered Virtual Population for Demand Simulation and Pricing

author.name: Chengpiao Huang, Kaizheng Wang

entry.summary: Develops an LLM-powered virtual population model representing customers as a finite mixture of personas to simulate demand and uncertainty for pricing decisions on text/image-described products. Aggregates persona-level purchase probabilities through calibrated mixture weights.

entry.title: ArtNet: A JEPA-Like Articulatory Predictive Framework for Robust Zero-Shot Phoneme Recognition

author.name: Zeqian Hu, Fuliang Weng, Shu Shang, Yaqian Zhou

entry.summary: ArtNet is a JEPA-like framework that predicts universal articulatory features from self-supervised speech representations, using a variational information bottleneck to suppress language-specific variation for zero-shot cross-lingual phoneme recognition. It improves robustness on seven unseen languages.

entry.title: Attention is Just Another Name for Coupling?: A Fast-Slow ODE Perspective on Hierarchical Pretraining

author.name: Zhengyuan Gao

entry.summary: This paper recasts self-attention as a coupling mechanism and proposes adding a slower second coupling subsystem on a downsampled sequence view, formalized via singularly perturbed ODEs. It explores whether fast-slow timescale separation complements standard attention.

entry.title: Semantic Flip: Synthetic OOD Generation for Robust Refusal in Embodied Question Answering and Spatial Localization

author.name: Dongbin Na, Chanwoo Kim, Giyun Choi, Dooyoung Hong

entry.summary: Semantic Flip synthesizes auxiliary out-of-distribution examples to teach embodied vision-language agents robust refusal, enabling them to say they do not know when visual memory cannot support a query. It targets overconfident answers in embodied QA and spatial localization.

entry.title: ActiveSAM: Image-Conditional Class Pruning for Fast and Accurate Open-Vocabulary Segmentation

author.name: Tran Dinh Tien, Zhiqiang Shen

entry.summary: ActiveSAM turns SAM 3 into a training-free active-vocabulary segmenter by estimating an image-conditioned active class set from a low-resolution preview and decoding only retained classes at full resolution. This avoids inefficient full-vocabulary decoding for open-vocabulary semantic segmentation.

entry.title: {\alpha}-Fair Insurance Pricing: A Fairness Continuum

author.name: Tianhe Zhang, Xiguang Liu, Peng Shi

entry.summary: This paper proposes alpha-fair insurance pricing as a continuum interpolating between actuarial fairness (risk differentiation) and solidarity fairness (cross-subsidization). It provides a tunable framework to navigate the tension as granular data enable finer risk differentiation.

entry.title: Unlocking Latent Dimensions: Exploring Representations of Large-Scale X-ray Scattering Data using Variational Autoencoders

author.name: Monika Choudhary, Xiaoya Chong, Runbo Jiang, Wiebke Koepp, Petrus H. Zwart, Damon English, Gregory M. Su, Eric Schaible, Chenhui Zhu, Mostafa Nassr, Noah P. Wamble, Kelvin Kam-Yun Li, Jonathan M. Chan, Jose Carlos Diaz, Cameron McKay, Lynn Katz, Benny Freeman, Guillaume Freychet, Yevgen Matviychuk, Eliot Gann, Daniel B. Allan, Benedikt Sochor, Frank Schluenzen, Stephan V. Roth, Ethan Crumlin, Dylan McReynolds, Tanny Chavez, Alexander Hexemer

entry.summary: This work trains an attention-based convolutional variational autoencoder on 1.5 million X-ray scattering images to learn low-dimensional representations capturing structural variation, supporting both offline exploration and live on-the-fly analysis. The latent space reveals organized clusters and smooth experimental trajectories.

entry.title: Diversity-Driven Offline Multi-Objective Optimization via Nested Pareto Set Learning

author.name: Yiyi Zhu, Yaolin Wen, Xiang Xia, Xin An, Hanyi Si, Xiang Shu, Yangde Fu, Liang Dou, Hong Qian

entry.summary: This paper proposes nested Pareto set learning for offline multi-objective optimization that improves diversity and mitigates the out-of-distribution bias where surrogate errors push solutions toward Pareto-front extremes. It learns the Pareto set from a fixed dataset without true objective access.

entry.title: Probabilistic Signature Inversion: Learning Conditional Distributions from Truncated Signatures

author.name: Junoh Kang, Kiseop Lee, Bohyung Han

entry.summary: Reframes truncated signature inversion as learning a conditional distribution of paths given the signature, using signature-conditioned flow matching since the truncated map is non-injective. Derives Bayes-optimal reconstruction error under linear statistics.

entry.title: David vs. Goliath in Next Activity Prediction: Argmax vs. LSTM, Transformer, and LLM

author.name: Hans Weytjens, Ingo Weber

entry.summary: Benchmarks LLMs, scratch-trained Transformers, LLM-distilled Transformers, and LSTMs against a simple counting-based argmax baseline for next-activity prediction across seven real event logs. Investigates whether model complexity actually pays off in predictive process monitoring.

entry.title: Inference-Time Decision Calibration for Temporal Classification

author.name: Arthur Chagas, Arthur Buzelin, Yan Aquino, Pedro Bento, Gisele L. Pappa, Wagner Meira Jr., Cristiano Arbex Valle

entry.summary: Proposes a representation-calibration decomposition for temporal classification, keeping a frozen classifier and adding inference-time interventions: a residual multi-scale branch and a branch-aware calibrator. Distinguishes missing temporal evidence from underused decision-level evidence across five benchmarks.

entry.title: Reinforcement Learning-Guided Retrieval with Soft Fusion for Robust Multimodal Imitation Learning under Missing Modalities

author.name: Hassan Ismkhan, Hamid Bouchahcia

entry.summary: Introduces RL4IL, a reinforcement-learning-guided imitation learning method for robotics that retrieves relevant expert demonstrations and uses soft fusion to handle missing input modalities like failed sensors or dropped instructions. Targets robustness for real-world robot deployment.

entry.title: Learning a Sampling-Free Variational DNN Plugin from Tiny Training Sets to Refine OOD Segmentation With Uncertainty Estimation

author.name: Jimut B. Pal, Suyash P. Awate

entry.summary: Introduces VarDeepPCA, a lightweight sampling-free variational DNN plugin that refines degraded out-of-distribution segmentation maps using geometric priors learned from small in-distribution datasets, with uncertainty estimation. Avoids costly retraining or target-domain data for medical imaging robustness.

entry.title: Spectral Adaptive Conformal Prediction for Structured Non-Exchangeable Data

author.name: Jeffery Opoku, David Banahene

entry.summary: Proposes spectral adaptive conformal prediction for structured non-exchangeable time-indexed data, forming weighted conformal quantiles using local spectral similarity and online miscoverage updates. Provides approximate coverage guarantees.

entry.title: Scaling Human and G2P Supervision for Robust Phonetic Transcription

author.name: Alexander Metzger, Aruna Srivastava, Ruslan Mukhamedvaleev

entry.summary: Studies how automatic phonetic transcription scales with human versus G2P supervision, identifying a quality threshold where G2P labels only help below 20-30 hours of human annotation. Shows ASR pretraining is effective beyond that threshold, achieving a 2.3x error reduction.

entry.title: Differentiable Packing of Irregular 3D Objects with Adaptive Container Estimation

author.name: Palak Gupta, Shanmuganathan Raman

entry.summary: Presents a differentiable 3D packing framework that jointly optimizes all object pose parameters and all three container dimensions in a single gradient-based loop using physics-inspired differentiable losses on meshes. Includes an adaptive squeezing mechanism that progressively tightens the container.

entry.title: Variational Deep Unfolding with Mamba-Based Nonlocal Modeling for Underwater Image Enhancement

author.name: Daniel Torres, Julia Navarro, Catalina Sbert, Joan Duran

entry.summary: This work presents a model-based deep unfolding network for underwater image enhancement integrating variational dehazing modeling with Mamba-based nonlocal layers. It provides theoretical analysis of solution existence and preserves structural detail via nonlocal gradient constraints.

entry.title: Trusted Multi-View Deep Learning Classification of Fetal Congenital Heart Disease with Feature-level and Decision-level Fusion

author.name: Tan Zhou, Shifa Yao, Suncheng Xiang, Dahong Qian, Baoying Ye

entry.summary: This study presents a trusted multi-view deep learning framework for binary classification of fetal congenital heart disease using five echocardiographic views, with feature-level and decision-level fusion plus uncertainty-based decision-making. It integrates multi-angle image data for improved diagnostic reliability.

entry.title: EmoZone-Talker: Regional Semantic Control of Audio-Driven 3DGS Talking Heads via Facial Action Units

author.name: Tingting Chen, Shaojun Wang, Huaye Zhang, Diqiong Jiang, Chenglizhao Chen

entry.summary: EmoZone-Talker enables fine-grained, interpretable facial expression control of audio-driven 3D Gaussian Splatting talking heads via facial action units, reformulating animation as spatial-temporal coordination under cross-modal conflicts. Introduces Synergy Zones for spatial disentanglement.

entry.title: PointDiffusion: Diffusion-Based Scene Completion in the Point Cloud Domain

author.name: Chidera Agbasiere, Mikhail Sannikov, Faith Ogunwoye, Erik Shaikhiev, Alex Kozinov, Ilya Mikhalchuk, Iana Zhura, Dzmitry Tsetserukou

entry.summary: PointDiffusion performs diffusion-based 3D scene completion directly in the point cloud domain for sparse LiDAR in autonomous driving, using a multi-token Gaussian VAE with cross-attention pooling and an anchor-based ICP ground-truth refinement to combat odometry drift. Also addresses multi-step inference latency.

entry.title: Multimodal LLM-Empowered Re-Ranking for Generalizable Person Re-Identification

author.name: Jiachen Li, Xiaojin Gong

entry.summary: Improves domain-generalizable person re-identification by enhancing inference-time re-ranking with multimodal LLMs, rather than only training generalizable encoders. Uses MLLM reasoning to refine ranking lists that conventional neighborhood-distance methods degrade on unseen domains.

entry.title: GRACE: Boosting Video MLLMs with Grounded Action-Centric Evidence for Viewer Sentiment Prediction

author.name: Ruoxuan Yang, Tieyuan Chen, Xiaofeng Huang, Haibing Yin, Jun Wang, Xiping Chen, Jun Yin, Xuesong Gao, Weiyao Lin

entry.summary: GRACE augments video MLLMs with grounded action-centric evidence (explicit event structure and localized visual cues) to better predict viewer sentiment in video advertisements, addressing the limits of holistic frame representations. Bridges what is shown and what is felt.

entry.title: Vision-Language Models as Zero-Annotation Oracles in Histopathology

author.name: Vishal Jain, Giorgio Buzzanca, Sarah Cechnicka, Maarten Naesens, Priyanka Koshy, Tri Nguyen, Jesper Kers, Candice Roufosse, Bernhard Kainz

entry.summary: This work recasts histopathology foreground segmentation as a natural-image perception task and uses general-purpose vision-language models as zero-annotation oracles, arguing tissue-versus-background discrimination generalizes where domain models fail. It introduces the Leica-75 benchmark covering specialized stains.

entry.title: R2RDreamer: 3D-aware Data Augmentation for Spatially-generalized 2D Manipulation Policies

author.name: Xiuwei Xu, Haowen Sun, Angyuan Ma, Yiwei Zhang, Zhenyu Wu, Xiaofeng Wang, Bingyao Yu, Zheng Zhu, Jie Zhou, Jiwen Lu

entry.summary: R2RDreamer is a 3D-aware real-to-real data augmentation method for spatially generalized 2D manipulation policies that jointly edits 3D observations and action trajectories from few source demonstrations. It reduces reliance on the strong 3D scene parsing and geometry completion that prior real-to-real methods require.

entry.title: Generative Predictive Distributions for Time Series

author.name: Jordi Llorens-Terrazas, Mika Meitz

entry.summary: Proposes a flexible generative framework for modeling predictive distributions of nonlinear multivariate time series using conditional GANs, enabling direct simulation-based computation of forecasts, fan charts, value at risk, and tail risks. It provides formal statistical analysis of estimation under this generative representation.

entry.title: Synthetic Counteradaptation: A Principle of Human-AI Co-evolution

author.name: Ivar Frisch, Jackie Kay, Philip Moreira Tomei

entry.summary: Introduces synthetic counteradaptation, a conceptual framework for how humans and AI co-evolve by adapting to each other's novel strategies, illustrated through Go, mixed-motive interactions, and geopolitical simulations. Authored by DeepMind-affiliated researchers.

entry.title: Integrating Reasoning and Generalization in Text-to-SQL via Self-Enhanced Fine-Tuning

author.name: Feng Lyu, Jinfeng Cen, Sijing Duan, Hao Wu, Shucheng Li, Weixu Zhang, Haolun Wu

entry.summary: CoTE-SQL improves LLM-based text-to-SQL via self-enhanced reasoning traces distilled without human annotation, structured chain-of-thought with modular decomposition, and error-aware revision from execution feedback. Aims to balance reasoning and generalization.

entry.title: Towards Next-Generation Healthcare: A Survey of Medical Embodied AI for Perception, Decision-Making, and Action

author.name: Cheng Zhang, Qing Cai, Xingzheng Wu, Xun Yang, Xiaojun Chang, Bingkun Bao, Liqiang Nie, Xinwang Liu, Yi Yang

entry.summary: A survey of medical embodied AI covering perception, decision-making, and action in clinical environments, framing intelligent agents as integrated end-to-end systems. Maps the rapidly expanding field for healthcare applications.

entry.title: SciText2Eq: Assessing LLMs for Explainable Equation Generation for Scientific Creativity

author.name: Yifan Mo, Xiao Fu, Yue Su, Qingyu Meng, Koen Hindriks, Qingzhi Liu, Jiahuan Pei

entry.summary: SciText2Eq assesses LLMs' ability to generate mathematical equations from scientific text, constructing a dataset of AI research papers paired with ground-truth equations and an evaluation protocol combining automatic metrics, LLM rubrics, and human judgments. Targets explainable equation generation for scientific creativity.

entry.title: Measuring Whether LLM Tutors Teach or Solve: A Diagnostic for Educational Impact

author.name: Junyi Yao, Zihao Zheng, Baichuan Li

entry.summary: Proposes a lightweight diagnostic that measures the gap between LLM tutors' problem-solving ability and their pedagogical support, finding only partial alignment (correlation 0.421) on MathTutorBench. Highlights that stronger task-solving does not imply better teaching.

entry.title: GIST-CMTF: Goal-State Inference for Causal Minimal Tool Filtering in LLM Agents

author.name: Rahul Suresh Babu, Rohit Shukla

entry.summary: GIST-CMTF adds a goal-state inference layer atop causal minimal tool filtering to handle ambiguous user requests that could map to multiple goals, preventing wrong-goal execution in tool-augmented agents. Predicts candidate symbolic goals and estimates ambiguity before applying tool filtering.

entry.title: A Causal Model of Theory of Mind in Conflict for Artificial Intelligence

author.name: Nikolos Gurney

entry.summary: Presents a structural causal model (DAG) formalizing when theory of mind engagement is causally warranted in conflict, treating ToM as a condition-activated mechanism rather than an always-on capacity. Specifies exogenous situational/agent variables driving ToM engagement decisions.

entry.title: Phishing Email Detection Using Large Language Models

author.name: Najmul Hasan, Prashanth BusiReddyGari, Haitao Zhao, Yihao Ren, Jinsheng Xu, Shaohu Zhang

entry.summary: LLMPEA is a framework using frontier LLMs to detect phishing emails across multiple attack vectors including prompt injection, text refinement, and multilingual attacks, evaluating GPT-4o, Claude Sonnet 4, and Grok-3. Argues current LLMs need substantial hardening before deployment in email security.

entry.title: Agentomics: Economic Foundations for the Valuation, Attribution, and Pricing of AI Agents in Human-AI Workflows

author.name: Quanyan Zhu

entry.summary: Agentomics proposes an economic framework for valuing, attributing, and pricing AI agents within human-AI workflows, treating workflow value as a team-level quantity with complementarities and bottlenecks. It shifts agent evaluation from isolated technical metrics toward economic contribution.

entry.title: PANDA: An LLM-Enhanced Performance-Driven Analog Design Framework Bridging Design Intent and Layout Generation

author.name: Haoyi Zhang, Weijian Fan, Xiaohan Gao, Bingyang Liu, Runsheng Wang, Yibo Lin

entry.summary: PANDA is an LLM-enhanced analog circuit design framework that bridges high-level design intent to final layout by managing cross-stage dependencies across topology synthesis, sizing, and layout. It reduces turnaround from days/weeks to hours while improving performance.

entry.title: MimicIK: Real-Time Generative Inverse Kinematics from Teleoperation with FK Consistency

author.name: Jiahao Yang, Shenhao Yan, Fan Feng, Chengsi Yao, Ge Wang, Zhixin Mai, Yiming Zhao, Yatong Han

entry.summary: MimicIK is a real-time generative inverse kinematics framework that learns smooth joint-space motion priors from noisy teleoperation demonstrations using conditional flow matching with forward-kinematics consistency. It targets stable real-time robot manipulation, avoiding discontinuous branch switching of classical solvers.

entry.title: CAP: Towards PPG Universal Representation Learning with Patient-level Supervision

author.name: Chenyang He, Xinyi Shao, Shun Huang, Bosong Huang, Daoqiang Zhang, Ming Jing, Cheng Ding

entry.summary: CAP is a PPG representation learning approach that anchors signal representations to patient-level electronic health records via cross-modal contrastive alignment, moving beyond signal-only objectives. It builds a large paired PPG-EHR dataset by distilling fragmented medical records into cohesive patient-level histories.

entry.title: Let LLMs Judge Each Other: Multi-Agent Peer-Reviewed Reasoning for Medical Question Answering

author.name: Zaifu Zhan, Shuang Zhou, Rui Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-agent peer-review reasoning method where multiple LLM agents generate chain-of-thought answers then evaluate each other to select the best reasoning chain for medical QA. Tested on five models across three medical benchmarks.

entry.title: Beyond Classification: A Cough Regression Benchmark for Respiratory Acoustic Foundation Models

author.name: Mayur Sanap, Prasanna Desikan, Edgar Lobaton

entry.summary: Introduces a cough regression benchmark for respiratory acoustic foundation models, evaluating five FMs across six continuous health targets (age, BMI, disease probability) under subject-disjoint protocols. Moves beyond classification to continuous prediction.

entry.title: Domain-Guided Prompting of the Segment Anything Model for Seismic Interpretation: The Role of Attributes, Visualization, and Hybrid Prompts

author.name: Aniq Ahmad, Heather Bedle, Ahmad Mustafa

entry.summary: Introduces a principled framework for zero-shot adaptation of the Segment Anything Model to seismic interpretation using domain-guided prompting, aligning seismic attributes with appropriate visualizations and hybrid prompts to avoid costly fine-tuning. Preserves generalization while improving geological segmentation.

entry.title: PreLort: Prefix-Nested LoRA for Federated Fine-Tuning under Rank Heterogeneity

author.name: Muhammad Waseem, Nurbek Tastan, Andrej Jovanovic, Nicholas D. Lane, Nils Lukas, Karthik Nandakumar, Samuel Horvath

entry.summary: Proposes PreLort, a nested prefix-hierarchy LoRA formulation for federated fine-tuning under heterogeneous client adapter ranks, ensuring lower ranks encode task-relevant information. Improves on existing rank-heterogeneous aggregation methods.

entry.title: Phys-JEPA: Physics-Informed Latent World Models for Multivariate Time-Series Forecasting

author.name: Weizhi Nie, Weichao Liu, Honglin Guo, Yuting Su

entry.summary: Introduces Phys-JEPA, a physics-informed joint-embedding predictive architecture for multivariate time-series forecasting that decomposes latent predictive states into physical and residual components. Aims to make hidden predictive states physically structured rather than merely statistically useful.

entry.title: LUCID: Learned Undersampling-Adaptive Consistency-Guided Inference with Deterministic Flow Matching for Sparse-View CT Reconstruction

author.name: Jigang Duan, Jiayi Wang, Heran Wang, Ping Yang, Genwei Ma, Xing Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes LUCID, a sparsity-adaptive consistency-guided sparse-view CT reconstruction framework built on a flow-matching generative prior trained only on high-quality images. Adapts to varying undersampling settings while avoiding anatomically inconsistent hallucinations.

entry.title: Propagating Structural Guidance: Synthesizing Fluorescein Angiography from Fundus Images and Sparse OCT Scans

author.name: Tengfei Ma, Ruiqi Wu, Chenran Zhang, Ye Geng, Na Su, Xiangyuan Duanmu, Tao Zhou, Yi Zhou, Wen Fan

entry.summary: Proposes a framework synthesizing fundus fluorescein angiography from non-invasive color fundus photography with structural guidance from sparse OCT scans. Constructs the first tri-modally aligned retinal imaging dataset from 3,676 patient eyes.

entry.title: Is Your Trajectory Displacement Safe in Long-tail?

author.name: Qiao Sun, Weicheng Zheng, Yixin Huang, Hang Zhao

entry.summary: Reframes autonomous driving planning evaluation as additional-threat detection, asking whether a planner's displacement introduces new unsafe behavior relative to an expert reference. Proposes FluidTest with a human annotation protocol, a 32-threat taxonomy, and evidence-grounded evaluation.

entry.title: SMEPilot: Characterizing and Optimizing LLM Inference with Scalable Matrix Extensions

author.name: Feiyang Chen, Haibo Chen

entry.summary: Provides a roofline-based characterization of Arm Scalable Matrix Extension CPUs for LLM inference and presents SMEPilot, an engine that selects CPU-only, SME-only, or cooperative execution per operator. Addresses mismatched arithmetic intensities across prefill, decode, attention, and KV-cache.

entry.title: Lost at the End: Primacy Bias in Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering

author.name: Jieyuan Liu, Jianyang Gu, Shijie Chen, Jefferson Chen, Zhen Wang

entry.summary: This work probes whether the lost-in-the-middle positional bias of text LLMs transfers to multimodal retrieval-augmented VQA, finding a primacy-leaning pattern via a controlled gold-position protocol. It matters for understanding reliability of deployed KB-VQA systems.

entry.title: PATCH: Action-Chunk-Conditioned Latent Patch Innovation Monitoring for Robot Manipulation

author.name: Yanan Zhou, Ranpeng Qiu, Yincong Chen, Jiajie Cui, Weiming Zhi

entry.summary: PATCH is an action-chunk-conditioned latent patch monitor that detects deployment-time execution risk in robot manipulation by predicting an expected execution corridor and flagging local anomalies. It distinguishes task-relevant risk from benign visual variation.

entry.title: MuVAP: Multimodal Multiparty Voice Activity Projection for Turn-taking Prediction in the Wild

author.name: Haotian Qi, Gabriel Skantze

entry.summary: MuVAP extends Voice Activity Projection to multiparty turn-taking using monaural audio and a single camera, introducing Role-Relative Projection to handle combinatorial speaker complexity and a new audiovisual dataset. It targets practical human-robot interaction setups.

entry.title: Upper Bounds on the Generalization Error of Deep Learning Models via Local Robustness and Stability

author.name: Abdul-Rauf Nuhu, Parham M. Kebria, Vahid Hemmati, Mahmoud N. Mahmoud, Edward Tunstel, Abdollah Homaifar
