entry.summary: Introduces BrainSurgery, a tool for reproducible declarative weight manipulations on neural network checkpoints via YAML plans, supporting layer restructuring, precision casting, low-rank factorization, and LoRA extraction. Replaces fragile ad-hoc scripts. Useful infrastructure for model editing and upcycling.

entry.title: Zero Touch Predictive Orchestration: Automating Time-Series Models for the Cloud-Edge Continuum

author.name: Abd Elghani Meliani, Arora Sagar, Adlen Ksentini, Raymond Knopp

entry.summary: Proposes a fully automated time-series prediction architecture for the Cloud-Edge Continuum that solves the cold-start problem for newly discovered nodes via a data-mixing methodology and a lightweight Resource Exposer. Enables proactive Zero Touch Management. Applied systems/forecasting contribution.

entry.title: A systematic investigation of molecular encoding methods for drug property predictions across neural network and Transformer encoder-based model

author.name: Sheng-Ya Chen, Shan-Ju Yeh

entry.summary: Systematically investigates how different molecular encoding methods (topological, substructure-based, and string-based fingerprints) affect drug property prediction across an MLP and a Transformer-encoder model on seven datasets. Provides guidance on optimal encodings for molecular property prediction.

entry.title: Integrating gene regulatory priors into Transformer attention with scTransformer for interpretable scRNA-seq analysis

author.name: Mikele Milia, Louis Fabrice Tshimanga, Henning Mueller, Manfredo Atzori, Barbara Di Camillo

entry.summary: Presents scTransformer, which embeds known gene regulatory structure into transformer attention to improve interpretability and robustness in single-cell RNA-seq analysis. Tests whether biological priors aid both performance and insight.

entry.title: ROSUM-MCTS: Monte Carlo Tree Search-Inspired HDL Code Summarization with Structural Rewards

author.name: Prashanth Vijayaraghavan, Charles Mackin, Luyao Shi, Apoorva Nitsure, Ashutosh Jadhav, David Beymer, Tyler Baldwin, Ehsan Degan, Vandana Mukherjee

entry.summary: Proposes ROSUM-MCTS, an MCTS-inspired LLM approach for hardware description language code summarization using structural rewards balancing functional correctness, content adequacy, and fluency. Targets the underexplored HDL summarization domain.

entry.title: ClinicalAligner26AM: A Cross-Lingual Aligner for Dataset Translation; Evidences from the MultiClinCorpus Shared Task

author.name: Fran\c{c}ois Remy

entry.summary: Introduces ClinicalAligner26AM, a large-context multilingual word-alignment model for biomedical and clinical text trained via Sinkhorn optimal-transport sharpening and distillation of fused multi-level alignment signals. Targets specialized-domain cross-lingual annotation projection.

entry.title: How Far Can Prompting Go for Minimal-Edit Ukrainian Grammatical Error Correction?

author.name: Kateryna Karpo, Artem Chernodub

entry.summary: Evaluates 11 commercial and one open-source LLM on Ukrainian minimal-edit grammatical error correction, finding the best configuration closes over 90% of the gap to fine-tuned state of the art. It shows language-specific minimal-edit prompts outperform other strategies.

entry.title: Trustworthy Visual Predicates for Robust Manipulation Understanding under Degradation

author.name: Fatemeh Ziaeetabar

entry.summary: This paper proposes a predicate-level reliability framework for manipulation understanding, measuring how visual relational predicates (contact, grasp, support) degrade under blur, occlusion, and noise. It provides confidence-aware metrics for robustness analysis.

entry.title: Self-supervised Learning Matters: A Simple Ensemble Solution for Micro-Gesture Recognition

author.name: Tingyi Liu, Kun Li, Fei Wang, Junjie Chen, Zhiliang Wu, Jihao Gu, Haixu Liu, Dan Guo

entry.summary: A challenge-winning ensemble for micro-gesture recognition combines a self-supervised masked-video-modeling RGB model with supervised multi-stream models. The self-supervised RGB baseline alone achieves strong accuracy, demonstrating value of in-domain unlabeled pretraining.

entry.title: Frequency-Scale Saliency for Spectral Descriptor Analysis in 3D Shape Retrieval

author.name: Jianru Shen

entry.summary: This work introduces a frequency-scale saliency framework to audit classical spectral descriptors (HKS, WKS) for 3D shape retrieval by quantifying each scale interval's contribution via ablation. It finds short scales dominate retrieval while long scales can harm performance.

entry.title: Systems-Level Planning and Coordination of Truck-Drone Collaborative Delivery Networks

author.name: Didem Cicek, Burak Kantarci

entry.summary: This paper proposes a five-layer planning and coordination framework for truck-drone collaborative last-mile delivery from a systems and control perspective, spanning spatial-demand alignment to scalable orchestration. It treats the problem as a networked cyber-physical delivery paradigm.

entry.title: Integrating Deep Learning Demand Forecasting with Multi-Objective Optimization for Circular Coffee Supply Chains: A Data-Driven Framework for Cost, Emissions, and Freshness Management

author.name: Ger\c{c}ek Budak (Department of Industrial Engineering, Ankara Y{\i}ld{\i}r{\i}m Beyaz{\i}t University, Ke\c{c}i\"oren, Ankara 06010, T\"urkiye), Faraz Gholamzadeh Gharehgheshlaghi (Department of Industrial Engineering, Ankara Y{\i}ld{\i}r{\i}m Beyaz{\i}t University, Ke\c{c}i\"oren, Ankara 06010, T\"urkiye), Melika Barjesteh Vaezi (Department of Kinesiology and Sport Management, Texas Tech University, Lubbock, TX, United States), Ahmad Gholizadeh Lonbar (Department of Civil, Construction, and Environmental Engineering, University of Alabama, Tuscaloosa, AL, USA)

entry.summary: This work integrates a CNN-LSTM demand-forecasting model with tri-objective mixed-integer optimization for circular coffee supply chains, balancing cost, emissions, and freshness. It reports strong forecasting accuracy and connects forecasting, optimization, and traceability often treated separately.

entry.title: A Multi-Agent System for IPMSM Design Optimization via an FEA-AI Hybrid Approach

author.name: Jinseong Han, Sunwoong Yang, Namwoo Kang

entry.summary: This work proposes a multi-agent IPMSM motor design optimization framework integrating retrieval-augmented generation for problem definition with an uncertainty-aware FEA-AI hybrid optimization pipeline. A RAG-connected design agent provides domain knowledge to automate setup.

entry.title: From Coarse to Fine: Managing Temporal Granularity in Spatio-Temporal Data for Fine-Grained Traffic Prediction

author.name: Shuhao Li, Weidong Yang, Yue Cui, Zizhuo Xu, Lipeng Ma, Fan Zhang, Xiaofang Zhou

entry.summary: This work formulates predicting fine-grained future traffic from coarse-grained sampled data to address temporal granularity mismatch in spatio-temporal data systems, reducing storage and computation costs. It proposes a spatial-temporal model for this novel problem.

entry.title: mllm-shap: A Shapley Value Explainability Platform for Text-Audio Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Jakub Muszy\'nski, Pawe{\l} Pozorski, Maria Ganzha

entry.summary: Introduces mllm-shap, an open-source framework extending Shapley value explainability to text-audio multimodal LLMs, with modality-aware masking, multi-turn tracking, and phonetic alignment-based grouping that cuts coalition space 10x-50x. Makes SV estimation feasible for multimodal models.

entry.title: Accelerating Birkhoff Projection for Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections

author.name: Chenrui Wang, Yixuan Qiu

entry.summary: Develops an accelerated, accurate end-to-end Birkhoff projection for 4x4 manifold-constrained hyper-connections, replacing slow Sinkhorn-Knopp iteration unrolling that adds compute and memory overhead. Improves stability guarantees of doubly-stochastic residual mixing.

entry.title: Outage Detection in Self-Healing Smart Grids Using Reinforcement Learning with Spectral Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Lihui Liu, Mucun Sun, Caisheng Wang

entry.summary: Combines reinforcement learning with spectral graph neural networks for outage detection and network reconfiguration in self-healing smart grids, capturing relational structure that spatial GNNs miss. Targets fast, low-cost outage mitigation.

entry.title: Structured Neuron Pruning in Deep Neural Networks Using Multi-Armed Bandits

author.name: Salem Ameen, Sunil Vadera

entry.summary: Develops a structured neuron pruning framework treating each candidate neuron as a multi-armed bandit arm, using policies like UCB1, Thompson Sampling, and Hedge to estimate safe-removal rewards from loss changes. Enables hardware-friendly structured sparsity.

entry.title: DSFNet: Learning Dual-Domain Spectral Operators for Multi-Modality Spatio-Temporal Forecasting in Urban Transportation Systems

author.name: Yongchao Li, Yang Li, Zhuoxuan Li, Jun Chen, Chu Zhang, Jinde Cao, Leszek Rutkowski

entry.summary: DSFNet is a dual-domain spectral filtering network for multi-modality spatio-temporal traffic forecasting that explicitly models cross-variable couplings across modalities and heterogeneous spatial dependencies. It targets urban transportation forecasting under exogenous influences.

entry.title: SHIELD-IDS: Structurally Heterogeneous Ensemble with Integrated Layered Defense for Intrusion Detection Systems

author.name: Maryam Zaman, Muhammad Khuram Shahzad

entry.summary: SHIELD-IDS (IDS-Anta++) extends an adversarially robust intrusion detection ensemble with XGBoost and LightGBM models wrapped in a three-layer black-box defense including isolation-forest anomaly detection. It improves structural diversity for resistance against adversarial network-flow perturbations.

entry.title: AeroSpectra Sentinel: An Auditable LLM Prompt-Chaining Decision-Support Workflow for Acute Asthma Risk Assessment from Respiratory Sounds and Clinical Signals

author.name: Aueaphum Aueawatthanaphisut

entry.summary: AeroSpectra Sentinel is a client-side decision-support prototype for acute asthma risk assessment combining STFT respiratory sound analysis, lightweight ML screening, and a five-stage LLM prompt-chaining workflow. It emphasizes auditable, transparent clinical reasoning and safe escalation logic.

entry.title: Failure-Aware Refinement of Vision-Language Model for Lithography Defect Detection

author.name: Pangyun Jeong, Jiyeong Kong, Yuehua Hu, Dohee Jeong, Kyung-Tae Kang

entry.summary: Proposes a two-stage vision-language framework for semiconductor lithography defect detection: LoRA-fine-tuned Qwen3-VL predicts defects, then a refinement module trained on first-stage failures corrects errors. Targets false positives, missed defects, and misclassifications.

entry.title: Decoding Pedestrian Crossing Intention from Egocentric Vision via Vision Language Models

author.name: Danya Li, Xiang Su, Yan Feng, Rico Krueger

entry.summary: Studies decoding pedestrian crossing intentions from egocentric video by framing it as closed-ended VQA and benchmarking VLMs, finding zero-shot models exceed chance but lack higher-level traffic reasoning. Adapts VLMs via parameter-efficient fine-tuning for improvement.

entry.title: PhysScene: A Scene Graph Dataset for Scientific Visual Reasoning in Physics Experiments

author.name: Minghao Zou, Qingtian Zeng, Shangkun Liu, Yanda Meng, Guanghui Yue, Baoquan Zhao, Abdulmotaleb El Saddik, Wei Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces PhysScene, the first scene graph dataset for physics experiment scenes capturing specialized instruments and functional relations. It enables evaluation of relational reasoning in scientific experimental contexts underserved by generic datasets.

entry.title: Shape Formation for the Cooperative Transportation of Arbitrary Objects Using Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Mohamed Sayed, Wolfram Burgard, Tanja Katharina Kaiser

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-agent reinforcement learning approach for shape/pattern formation control to cooperatively transport arbitrarily-shaped objects with non-uniform mass distribution. It addresses formations that securely support real-world objects atop multi-robot systems.

entry.title: PTL-Diffusion: Manifold-Aware Diffusion with Periodic Terminal Laws

author.name: Danqi Zhuang, Jisui Huang, Xiaoyue Xi, Andrew Kiggins, Xiaojie Wang, Ke Chen, Yue Wu

entry.summary: Proposes PTL-Diffusion, a proof-of-concept diffusion framework whose forward process converges to a nonconstant periodic family of Gaussian terminal laws rather than a single invariant distribution. It aims to inject manifold structure for data concentrated near low-dimensional manifolds.

entry.title: Vessel Traffic Flow Prediction on Sparse Data via Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Networks with a Learnable Tweedie Head

author.name: Kyeongjun Lee, Heeyoung Kim

entry.summary: Proposes a model-agnostic learnable Tweedie output head for spatio-temporal GNNs to handle sparse, intermittent maritime traffic data with excess zeros and bursts. It improves over conventional ST-GNNs and zero-inflated models for vessel flow prediction.

entry.title: Conditional Random Ordered Transport Spaces

author.name: Lei Luo, Jian Yang

entry.summary: Introduces conditional random ordered transport spaces (CROTS), L0-valued spaces of random measures with a Wasserstein metric and stochastic order to certify whether mass moves in admissible directions. It targets evidence-constrained, causal, and risk-sensitive learning.

entry.title: Loss-Guided Adaptive Scale Refinement for Molecular Force Prediction

author.name: Limin Yu

entry.summary: Introduces a loss-guided adaptive scale refinement framework for molecular force prediction that treats predefined spatial scales as initial anchors and discovers task-optimal resolutions through interpolation and differentiable scale updates. Tested on a NaCl aqueous system. Niche molecular ML contribution.

entry.title: Quantifying Uncertainty in Space Debris Capture with Active Tether-Net Systems Caused by Noisy Observations

author.name: Feng Liu, Achira Boonrath, Eleonora M. Botta, Souma Chowdhury

entry.summary: Presents a pipeline to propagate and quantify uncertainty from noisy debris-state observations in active tether-net space debris capture systems, where decisions depend on robust net maneuver and closing choices. Applied uncertainty quantification for aerospace robotics. Niche but practically motivated.

entry.title: Non-Archimedean Polydisc Spaces and Applications to Optimisation

author.name: Paul Lezeau, Yiannis Fam, Anthea Monod, Yue Ren

entry.summary: Introduces non-Archimedean polydisc spaces inspired by Berkovich geometry as a new framework for optimization over hierarchical data, showing metric trees embed naturally and establishing geodesic properties. Proposes optimization-compatible functions for these spaces.

entry.title: QnRL: Quantum-Native Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Alexander DeRieux, Walid Saad

entry.summary: Proposes Quantum-Native Reinforcement Learning, a distributional RL framework that directly models environment random variables as quantum state distributions rather than estimating expected outcomes. Aims to exploit the distributional nature of quantum computers for greater expressive power in stochastic environments.

entry.title: Ishigaki-IDS: An Open-Weight Verifier-Aware Model for Information Delivery Specification Drafting in Building Information Modeling

author.name: Ryo Kanazawa, Koyo Hidaka, Teppei Miyamoto, Takayuki Kato, Tomoki Ando, Chenguang Wang, Dayuan Jiang, Naofumi Fujita, Shuhei Saitoh, Atomu Kondo, Koki Arakawa, Daiho Nishioka

entry.summary: Presents Ishigaki-IDS, an open-weight LLM specialized for verifier-aware Information Delivery Specification drafting in Building Information Modeling, combining continued pretraining, SFT, and RL with verifiable rewards. Addresses a practical BIM authoring bottleneck with schema-conformant generation.

entry.title: Detection and Interpretability Analysis of Quotation Errors by Large Language Models

author.name: Bei Huang, Yingyi Zhang, Shenghao Huang, Chengzhi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes an LLM-based task of automated detection of quotation errors, the inconsistency between cited information and original sources, with interpretability analysis. Addresses a prevalent and labor-intensive problem in academic integrity.

entry.title: HydraQE: OSU's Submission for the IWSLT 2026 Speech Translation Metrics Shared Task

author.name: Kevin Krahn, Eric Fosler-Lussier

entry.summary: Presents HydraQE, a reference-free speech-translation quality estimation system for IWSLT 2026 built on a Qwen3-ASR backbone with sparsemax layer mixing and three prediction heads trained on human and pseudo-label supervision. Addresses scarcity of human-annotated QE data.

entry.title: Toward Signing Activity Projection in Sign Language Interaction

author.name: Takao Obi, Wang Yusong, Koji Inoue, Kotaro Funakoshi

entry.summary: Presents an initial transfer study adapting Voice Activity Projection architectures to predictive turn-taking in dyadic sign language interaction, deriving signing activity streams from the Public DGS Corpus. It targets accessibility for signing users with social robots.

entry.title: Automated IEP Generation from Traditional Chinese Parent-Teacher Interviews via Corpus-Grounded Feature Diffusion

author.name: Kuanlin Chen, Cheng-En Ou

entry.summary: Proposes a low-resource fine-tuning pipeline using Corpus-Grounded Feature Diffusion to automatically generate Individualized Education Programs from Traditional Chinese parent-teacher interviews. It addresses domain data scarcity and privacy constraints in an unexplored language setting.

entry.title: DroneDAR: Long-Range Drone Distance Estimation Using Monocular Vision and Bounding-Box Features

author.name: Knut Peterson, Zaid Mayers, David Han

entry.summary: DroneDAR estimates long-range drone distance from monocular image crops combined with bounding-box geometry, using a convolutional backbone with a lightweight gating mechanism to integrate box-derived features. It addresses extreme target scale variation and background clutter.

entry.title: Local Search on Vertex Coloring for Bipartite Graphs

author.name: Johanna Gasse

entry.summary: This thesis analyzes local search landscapes for vertex coloring on differently structured bipartite graphs, identifying structures that guarantee only global optima versus those enabling arbitrarily bad non-global local optima. It characterizes when local search can succeed.

entry.title: DynaOD: Dynamic Origin-Destination Flow Generation with Discrete-to-Continuous Temporal Semantic Modeling

author.name: Jie Zhao, Xianqi Dai, Jie Feng, Huandong Wang, Yong Li

entry.summary: DynaOD generates dynamic origin-destination mobility flows from temporal context alone, modeling discrete directional trends and continuous temporal evolution to produce coherent OD patterns while preserving spatial heterogeneity. It does not rely on historical OD observations.

entry.title: Bidirectional Semantic Complementary Tool Retrieval for Remote Sensing Agents

author.name: Zeyuan Wang, Dongyang Hou, Cheng Yang, Xuezhi Cui, Linrui Xu, Bo Yu, Gaozhi Zhou, Ziyu Li, Liangtian Liu, Kai Ouyang, Wang Guo, Lili Zhu, Chao Tao

entry.summary: Proposes a bidirectional semantic complementary tool retrieval method for remote sensing LLM agents, addressing the semantic asymmetry between high-level queries and fine-grained tool documentation. Improves precise tool selection within context-window limits.

entry.title: An AI Security Agent for University ACMIS: Multi-Vector Threat Detection and Automated Response

author.name: Joseph Walusimbi, Joshua Benjamin Ssentongo

entry.summary: This paper presents an AI security agent for University Academic Management Information Systems combining supervised anomaly detection, behavioral analytics, and an NLP chatbot for secure password recovery. It monitors five operational layers to detect threats indistinguishable from normal operations.

entry.title: Deep Active Re-Labeling: Toward Noise-Resilient Annotation Efficiency

author.name: Md Abdullah Al Forhad, Weishi Shi

entry.summary: Deep Active Re-Labeling addresses the impact of human annotation errors in deep active learning by allocating part of the annotation budget to re-labeling, informed by human learning patterns. Aims for noise-resilient annotation efficiency.

entry.title: OnlyDense: Reduced-Order Modeling for Lagrangian simulation

author.name: Tu Do, Shannon Ryan, Santu Rana

entry.summary: OnlyDense proposes a learning framework for scalable reduced-order modeling of massive particle systems in Lagrangian simulations like SPH and MPM, avoiding the cost of graph-based per-particle methods. Targets expensive multi-scale physics simulations.

entry.title: Self-Paced Curriculum Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Superbike Racing in Simulation

author.name: Luca Ghisi, Jacopo Essenziale, Carlo D'Eramo, Matteo Luperto

entry.summary: Presents a self-paced curriculum reinforcement learning framework using Soft Actor-Critic to train autonomous superbike racing agents in a physics-accurate simulator, automatically generating progressively harder tasks. Tackles the added complexity of balance and lean-angle control in motorbikes.

entry.title: TriHead-GAN: A Generative Adversarial Network with Triple-Head Discriminator for Carbon Emission Time Series Generation

author.name: Zesen Wang, Lijuan Lan, Yonggang Li, Chunhua Yang

entry.summary: Proposes TriHead-GAN, a GAN with a triple-head discriminator for generating scarce city-level carbon emission time series, providing explicit supervision for cross-variable correlations and first-difference statistics. It addresses limitations of existing generators that match marginals but collapse domain structure.

entry.title: Measuring Poverty and Inequality with Reduced Data: A Machine Learning Approach Using Nigerian Household Data

author.name: Vanesa Jord\'a, Miguel Ni\~no-Zaraz\'ua

entry.summary: Applies Random Forest Recursive Feature Elimination to Nigerian household survey data to identify which income, consumption, and household features best classify welfare position, testing whether reduced survey instruments preserve distributional information. It targets cheaper poverty and inequality monitoring in low-income countries.

entry.title: On solving symmetric multi-type orthogonal non-negative matrix tri-factorization problem

author.name: Rok Hribar, Gregor Papa, Janez Povh, Andrej Kastrin

entry.summary: Develops heuristic algorithms (a KKT-based fixed-point method and another) for the symmetric multi-type orthogonal non-negative matrix tri-factorization problem with a shared orthogonal factor. It targets clustering and network analysis with interpretable, assignment-type structure.

entry.title: Constrained user-item allocation for e-commerce marketing campaigns

author.name: Maja Lindstr\"om, Natalija Glisovic, Jan von Pichowski, Tommy L\"ofstedt, Martin Rosvall

entry.summary: Formalizes e-commerce campaign design as auto-targeting, jointly selecting non-overlapping groups of users and items with strong mutual affinity, and proposes constrained spectral biclustering and complementary strategies. Combinatorial optimization for marketing. Applied recommendation contribution.

entry.title: What Does Debiasing Really Remove? A Geometric Study of PCA-Based Gender Debiasing in Word Embeddings

author.name: Alexey Kresin, Tchifou M. Dieffi, Tomer Caspi

entry.summary: Conducts a geometric analysis of PCA-based gender debiasing in word embeddings, confirming direct bias concentrates in the first principal component but questioning what else is destructively removed. Provides clarity on the low-rank bias hypothesis.

entry.title: Operationalizing Linguistic Methods through Prompt-Engineering Skills: An Automatic Chinese Web Neologism Detection Pipeline

author.name: Yufeng Wu, Meichun Liu

entry.summary: Presents a Chinese web neologism detection pipeline that operationalizes linguistic identification principles as prompt-engineering skills across four stages, applied to a 267M-document corpus producing nearly 5,000 labeled neologisms. Includes a per-stage conditional recall decomposition for evaluation.

entry.title: FMRFusion: Frequency-Aware Multi-View Representation Learning for Heterogeneous Image Fusion

author.name: Tao Zhoua, Yunlong Liu, Qinghui Chen, Zekai Zhang, Minlong Sun, Changlin Biana, Dagang Li, Wenmin Wang, Jinglin Zhang

entry.summary: FMRFusion is a frequency-aware multi-view representation learning network for fusing infrared and visible images, with a multi-scale structural perception module to better capture distinct modality characteristics. It targets robustness in real-world heterogeneous data scenarios.

entry.title: Personal Salience: Highlighting Is Social, but Individuality Lives in Selection

author.name: Kazuki Nakayashiki, Keisuke Watanabe

entry.summary: Studies how much of an individual is recoverable from social highlighting traces using a co-readership control that fixes document and topic, separating generic, crowd, and personal salience. It finds highlighting is largely social but individuality lives in selection.

entry.title: Real-Time Industrial Defect Detection on Edge Hardware Using Fine-Tuned YOLOv8: A Systematic Benchmark on the NEU Surface Defect Database and MVTec AD with Automotive & Battery Manufacturing Extensions

author.name: Emmanuel Ezeji Somtochukwu, Nitesh Rijal

entry.summary: Industrial-YOLO is an edge-optimized framework built on fine-tuned YOLOv8 for real-time surface defect detection, systematically benchmarked on NEU and MVTec AD datasets with automotive and battery manufacturing extensions. It targets low-latency deployment on resource-constrained hardware.

entry.title: Self-Explainability in Self-Adaptive and Self-Organising Systems: Status and Research Directions

author.name: Tom Beyer, Svea Wisy, Sven Tomforde

entry.summary: This systematic literature review surveys self-explainability in self-adaptive and self-organising systems, developing a unified definition, taxonomy, and Levels of Self-Explainability framework. It finds most current approaches remain conceptual with limited implementation.

entry.title: Retrieval Augmented Generation Framework for the Nepali Legal Domain Question Answering

author.name: Samir Wagle, Abiral Adhikari, Reewaj Khanal, Batsal Bhandari, Prashant Manandhar, Praveen Acharya, Bal Krishna Bal

entry.summary: Presents the first RAG-based legal question answering system for Nepali using case law from a national digital archive, achieving strong retrieval precision and groundedness. Important for extending LLM applications to low-resource languages and underserved legal domains.

entry.title: AMN: An Adaptive Multi-Scale Fusion Network with Boundary and Uncertainty Modeling for Nuclei Segmentation

author.name: Spoorthi M, Suja Palaniswamy

entry.summary: Presents AMN, a dual-encoder nuclei segmentation network combining a Swin Transformer and ResNet-50 feature pyramid fused via learned per-channel gating, with boundary and uncertainty modeling. Targets accurate nuclei subtype classification for tumor grading and prognosis.

entry.title: EssentialGIN: a new approach for gene essentiality prediction based on graph isomorphism neural networks

author.name: Sahar Mansouri-Rad, Zahra Narimani, Parvin Razzaghi, Nazanin Hosseinkhan

entry.summary: EssentialGIN uses graph isomorphism networks to predict essential genes by embedding proteins in PPI networks while integrating biological data such as gene expression and orthology. It aims to reduce false positives compared to centrality-based methods.

entry.title: Enhancing AI Interpretability and Safety through Localised Architectures

author.name: Ian Seet, Jonas Bozenhard, Simon Osterman

entry.summary: This paper advocates localized architectures combining interpretable, efficient local machine learning models to enhance interpretability, safety, and sustainability versus diffuse deep networks. It observes that localized ML tends to be more interpretable and efficient on small datasets.

entry.title: AgriGov: A Structured Multilingual Dataset Curation for Indian Government Schemes for Farmers

author.name: Mohsina Bilal, Gopakumar G

entry.summary: AgriGov is a curated trilingual (English-Hindi-Marathi) dataset of 50 Indian government farmer welfare schemes structured into semantic fields, addressing scarcity of domain-grounded multilingual agricultural policy resources. Translations combine machine translation pipelines with human post-editing.

entry.title: BioVid: Autoregressive Video Generation with Biological Behavior Semantic Comprehension

author.name: Tsung-Wei Pan, Jung-Hua Wang

entry.summary: BioVid is an autoregressive video generation framework that learns natural action duration distributions from biological behavior data rather than using fixed frame counts. It uses an FSQ-GAN tokenizer to encode frames and model temporal structure data-drivenly.

entry.title: PolyBuild: An End-to-End Method for Polygonal Building Contour Extraction from High-Resolution Remote Sensing Images

author.name: Yaoteng Zhang, Julin Zhang, Guangshuai Wang, Jiwei Deng, Hui Sheng, Yasir Muhammad, Shiqing Wei

entry.summary: PolyBuild is an end-to-end method extracting building polygon contours directly from high-resolution remote sensing images without post-processing. It avoids the error-prone pixel-segmentation-plus-postprocessing pipeline common in building extraction.

entry.title: Autonomous Incident Resolution at Hyperscale: An Agentic AI Architecture for Network Operations

author.name: Arun Malik

entry.summary: Presents an agentic AI architecture for autonomous incident resolution in hyperscale cloud network operations using multi-agent orchestration with hierarchical decomposition, runbook knowledge encoding, and progressive autonomy with safety boundaries. Aims to detect, diagnose, and remediate without human intervention.

entry.title: Can Data Work be Reparative?

author.name: Srravya Chandhiramowuli, Ding Wang, Alex Taylor

entry.summary: An ethnographic study of a feminist civic-tech initiative building online-safety datasets collaboratively with those harmed, examining whether data work can be reparative. It traces tensions around fair reward and collective governance of AI datasets.

entry.title: STARIXNet: Multivariate and Multi-attribute Deep Learning Approach to Real-Time Resource Allocation in Cloud Platforms

author.name: Ahmed Abdulaal, Maruf Aytekin, Thilaga kumaran Srinivasan, Tomer Lancewicki

entry.summary: Presents STARIXNet, a lightweight neural network for real-time multivariate resource allocation in cloud platforms that moves beyond univariate CPU-based scaling and addresses underestimation risks neglected by forecasting-focused methods. It captures spatio-temporal relations for scaling microservices.

entry.title: Graph Neural Networks for Predicting Solvability of Finite Groups

author.name: Tal Weissblat

entry.summary: Presents a Graph Neural Network framework to classify finite groups as solvable or non-solvable using Cayley graph representations and structural graph information alone. It is a proof-of-concept exploring whether GNNs can learn abstract algebraic properties.

entry.title: Intention Driven Identification of In-Possession Match Phases in Association Football through Temporal Graph Learning

author.name: Yuesen Li, Daniel Link

entry.summary: Proposes a data-driven, intention-driven framework using a Temporal Graph Attention Network to identify in-possession match phases in football from spatiotemporal tracking data, defining a hierarchical phase model. Sports analytics application of temporal graph learning. Niche domain contribution.

entry.title: Investigating Calibration Challenges in Probabilistic Electricity Price Forecasting

author.name: Jan Niklas Lettner, Hadeer El Ashhab, Benjamin Sch\"afer

entry.summary: Highlights calibration challenges in probabilistic electricity price forecasting, arguing that proper scoring rules favoring sharpness produce overconfident, miscalibrated uncertainty estimates as renewable integration raises volatility. Calls for calibration-aware objectives. Short position/analysis paper.

entry.title: Post-Rejection Follow-up Sampling: A Methodology for Counterfactual Outcome Measurement in Algorithmic DEX Trading

author.name: Arati Uday Kamat

entry.summary: Introduces Post-Rejection Follow-up Sampling, a methodology for measuring counterfactual outcomes of tokens rejected by algorithmic DEX trading filters by tracking their subsequent price and liquidity. Releases a dataset of 67k forward-outcome observations to evaluate filter precision against real market outcomes.

entry.title: Alcmean's: Unsupervised community detection using local Laplacian, automatic detection of the number of centers

author.name: Shahin Momenzadeh, Rojiar Pir Mohammadiani

entry.summary: Proposes ALCMeans, an unsupervised community detection algorithm combining Laplacian energy-based automatic center identification with DeepWalk embeddings, eliminating the need to predefine the number of communities. Aims to overcome manual parameter tuning and inaccurate center selection in methods like Louvain and LPA.

entry.title: ReadingMachine: A Computational Methodology for Structured Corpus Reading and Large-Scale Synthesis

author.name: James Morrissey

entry.summary: Introduces ReadingMachine, a methodology using LLMs for bounded structured reading over entire document collections via staged insight extraction, clustering, and omission detection rather than retrieval or summarization. Prioritizes coverage and traceability, demonstrated on 152 policy documents.

entry.title: Understanding the Sociocultural Dimensions of Mental Health Discourse in Arabic-Language X Communities

author.name: Amal Alqahtani (King Saud University, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia), Rana Salama (Cairo University, Egypt), Mona Diab (Carnegie Mellon University, Pittsburgh, USA)

entry.summary: Conducts an exploratory computational study of 8,147 Arabic tweets characterizing mental health discourse around BPD, bipolar disorder, and ADHD using a cultural keyword framework. Addresses the underexamination of non-English mental health discourse.

entry.title: TruthSplit: Operationalizing Conditional Validity in Arguments Through Multi-Perspective Reasoning

author.name: Benjamin Stieger, Maximilian Terberger, Thomas Huber, Christina Niklaus

entry.summary: TruthSplit is an interactive system for multi-perspective argument analysis that operationalizes conditional validity, showing how the same claim leads to different conclusions under worldview-specific values. It uses a three-layer natural language inference approach to assess logical and worldview-based validity.

entry.title: Cybernetic Android Avatar "Yui": System Integration, Field Deployment, and Evaluation

author.name: Kaoruko Shinkawa, Mizuki Nakajima, Taisei Mogi, Yoshihiro Nakata

entry.summary: Yui is a full-body cybernetic android avatar with 55 degrees of freedom combining immersive teleoperation with human-like social signaling for remote communication. The paper reports system integration and field deployment evaluation.

entry.title: Frequency-based Constrained Sampling for Interval Patterns

author.name: Djawad Bekkoucha, Abdelkader Ouali, Bruno Cr\'emilleux

entry.summary: CFips is a constrained output-space sampling approach for interval patterns under user-defined syntactic constraints, decomposing constraints into elementary predicates on interval bounds while preserving exact frequency-proportional sampling guarantees. It offers an alternative to exhaustive pattern mining.

entry.title: Bridging Traditional Explainability Methods and Multimodal Multilingual Models: An XAI-Based Analysis

author.name: Pawe{\l} Pozorski, Jakub Muszy\'nski, Maria Ganzha

entry.summary: Formalizes a multimodal extension of Shapley value attribution treating text tokens and aligned audio segments as cooperative features, addressing cross-channel dependencies and computational complexity. Companion analysis to the mllm-shap framework.

entry.title: Multimodal Group Emotion Recognition In-the-Wild Towards a Privacy-Safe Non-Individual Approach

author.name: Anderson Augusma

entry.summary: A thesis on privacy-preserving group emotion recognition in-the-wild using collective audio-video signals rather than individual cues, proposing a cross-attention fusion architecture and a variational multimodal framework. Reduces surveillance risk while inferring group-level emotion.

entry.title: AQIFormer: A Transformer-Based Multi-View Architecture for Cross-City Air Quality Classification

author.name: Om Kathalkar, Nitin Nilesh, Sachin Chaudhari, Anoop Namboodiri

entry.summary: Presents AQIFormer, a transformer-based multi-view ensemble for cross-city air quality classification from traffic-scene images, using dual-view integration, weather-aware attention, and multi-task learning. Targets scalable image-based pollution monitoring with better cross-city generalization.

entry.title: Multi-planar 2D-U-Net Segmentation of 3D-CT Abdominal Organs augmented by Spatial Occurrence Maps

author.name: Daria Kern, Negar Chabi, Souraj Adhikary, Andre Mastmeyer

entry.summary: This work presents a lightweight multi-planar 2D-U-Net framework for segmenting five abdominal organs in large field-of-view 3D CT scans, augmented with fuzzy 3D spatial occurrence maps providing anatomical location cues. It uses a coarse-to-fine two-stage approach.

entry.title: Hybrid Neural Network and Conventional Controller Approach for Robust Control of Highly Unstable Systems: Application to Tilt-Rotor Control

author.name: Ali Kafili Gavgani, Amin Talaeizadeh, Aria Alasty, Hossein Nejat Pishkenari

entry.summary: Presents a hybrid neural-network plus conventional controller approach for robust control of highly unstable tilt-rotor systems, including a deliberate negative result showing direct input-output neural control fails. Combines learning with classical control for full actuation.

entry.title: Context Rot in AI-Assisted Software Development: Repurposing Documentation Consistency for AI Configuration Artifacts

author.name: Christoph Treude, Sebastian Baltes

entry.summary: Reframes stale AI configuration files (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursorrules) as a context rot problem and repurposes decades of documentation-consistency research to address it. Argues existing doc-code consistency tooling applies to AI configuration artifacts.

entry.title: An Enhanced Geometric-Spectral Feature Learning Framework for Airborne Multispectral Point Cloud Classification

author.name: Xian Li, Yanfeng Gu, Aleksandra Pi\v{z}urica

entry.summary: Proposes an attention-based geometric-spectral feature learning framework with two-stream fusion for airborne multispectral point cloud classification, and builds two new MPC datasets. Addresses high-dimensional heterogeneous spatial-spectral data and class imbalance.

entry.title: Who Earns the Safety? Intervention-Aware Quantum Predictive Control with Safety Attribution

author.name: Yifan Wang

entry.summary: Introduces IA-VQC-DPC, an intervention-aware variational quantum predictive control method that measures whether the policy or its protective safety filter earns the safety, training under a primal-dual intervention budget. It addresses the problem that filtered controllers may learn nothing about safety.

entry.title: New Fractional Ambiguity Function Integrated with CNN-Based Machine Learning for Signal Classification

author.name: Aamir H. Dar, Prakhar Kumar Sonkar, Neeraj Kumar Sharma

entry.summary: Introduces a new fractional ambiguity function derived from the fractional Fourier transform, establishes its analytical properties, and integrates it as input features into a CNN for LFM signal classification. Claims superior time-frequency localization over spectrograms and classical ambiguity functions.

entry.title: Analyzing the Correlation Between Hallucinations and Knowledge Conflicts in Large Language Models

author.name: Lucrezia Laraspata, Giovanna Castellano, Gennaro Vessio

entry.summary: Investigates whether internal representations linked to knowledge conflicts correlate with hallucination behaviors using probing across hidden, attention, and MLP layers of LLaMA-3-8B and Falcon-7B. Finds the two phenomena are conceptually related but not strongly correlated internally.

entry.title: Traxia: A Framework for Verifiable, Agent-Native Scientific Publishing

author.name: Wisdom Dogah

entry.summary: Traxia proposes an agent-native scientific publishing framework where AI agents publish verifiable papers with reasoning traces, confidence intervals, cryptographic identities, peer-review one another, and collaborate with humans under shared provenance. It is a speculative infrastructure vision for verifiable AI-driven science.

entry.title: Evaluating Advanced Prompting on Gemini Flash for Multi-Hop Biomedical QA

author.name: Ahmed Bajaber, Mohammed Alliheedi

entry.summary: Evaluates advanced prompt engineering (role-play, multi-shot CoT, strict formatting) on Gemini 2.0 Flash for multi-hop biomedical QA, raising concept-level scores from 0.565 to 0.720 and matching a next-generation model. Demonstrates prompting can rival model upgrades.

entry.title: Selecting New Measurement Locations to Diversify Traffic-Pattern Coverage: A Real-World Evaluation for Total Traffic Volume Estimation

author.name: Masaaki Inoue, Akifumi Okuno, Shintaro Fukushima

entry.summary: Proposes a method for selecting new traffic measurement locations to diversify pattern coverage for city-wide total traffic volume estimation, evaluated in a real-world setting combining fixed counters with mobile-device data. Targets cost-effective transportation monitoring.

entry.title: Anchor-Conditioned Compositional Control for Landscape Image Generation

author.name: Gadha Lekshmi P, Govind Arun, Rohith Syam, Ahmed Elgammal

entry.summary: Presents early results on anchor-conditioned fine-tuning for landscape image generation, injecting a four-dimensional compositional anchor vector into a diffusion model via decoupled cross-attention with Fourier encoding and classifier-free guidance dropout. Improves horizon detection and rule-of-thirds alignment over baselines.

entry.title: Quantum-Enhanced Similarity Measures for Polarimetric Materials Classification

author.name: Sara Shojaei, Seyed Mohamad Ali Tousi, Emma Bennett, Param Sangani, Ali Shiri Sichani, Ilker Ersoy, Hadi Ali-Akbarpour, Filiz Bunyak, G. N. DeSouza

entry.summary: This paper presents a quantum-classical hybrid pipeline for polarimetric material classification, encoding learned voxel embeddings as quantum state amplitudes and using SWAP-test fidelity for similarity-based point matching. It frames material classification as a quantum-assisted point-matching problem.

entry.title: Agentic Search for Counterfactual Recourse under Fixed LLM Budgets

author.name: Yasuo Tabei

entry.summary: Studies generating multiple counterfactual recourse alternatives via LLM prompting under a fixed budget of LLM calls, framing it as agentic search to efficiently produce oracle-validated counterfactuals. Addresses the cost constraint of repeated LLM calls.

entry.title: Crop Recommendation and Agricultural Query Answering System Using Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Networks and Hybrid Retrieval Augmentation

author.name: Prajwal Thapa, Yagya Raj Pandeya

entry.summary: Presents a precision-agriculture system combining a transformer-based GNN and a spatio-temporal graph convolutional network for 30-day weather forecasting across 1,359 Nepal locations, plus crop recommendation and a hybrid-retrieval QA tool for farmers. STGCN outperforms the transformer variant.

entry.title: Airport Terminal Passenger Queue Forecasting for Departure Gates and Security Checkpoints

author.name: Juhwan Lee, Seokbin Yoon, Keumjin Lee, Hojong Baik, Seyeon Jung

entry.summary: Proposes a Transformer-based framework for forecasting passenger queues at airport departure gates and security checkpoints, capturing temporal dependencies and inter-facility correlations from operational data. It maps learned representations to facility-specific queue and waiting-time predictions for proactive congestion management.

entry.title: Evaluating the Impact of Task Granularity on Catastrophic Forgetting in Continual Learning

author.name: Emre Alyamac, Himanshu Janmeda, Shashwat Krishna, Yash Vijay

entry.summary: Investigates whether learning order (coarse-to-fine vs fine-to-coarse vs flat) affects catastrophic forgetting in continual learning on CIFAR-100. It tests three curricula to see if hierarchical sequencing reduces forgetting.

entry.title: Forward-Looking Stress Testing Under Macro Scenarios: Stable SVaR Estimation Using a Hybrid GPR-HS Framework with SACS

author.name: Ujjwala Vadrevu

entry.summary: Extends a hybrid Gaussian Process Regression Historical Simulation framework to forward-looking regulatory stress testing for Stressed Value-at-Risk, introducing Scenario-Averaged Covariance Stabilization for numerical stability across war, climate, and AI-bubble scenarios. Applied financial risk methodology. Niche regulatory finance contribution.

entry.title: From Genes to Tokens: a GWAS-inspired Approach for Interpretable Stylometric Analysis

author.name: Dmitry Pronin, Evgeny Kazartsev

entry.summary: Introduces a GWAS-inspired stylometric interpretation method where token associations with authorship are tested via logistic regression with multiple-comparison correction across English, German, and Russian corpora. It detects statistically significant author-distinctive lexical markers.

entry.title: SoccerNet 2026 Player-Centric Ball-Action Spotting:Retraining and Post-Processing Extensions to the FOOTPASS Baselines

author.name: Parthsarthi Rawat

entry.summary: This system for the SoccerNet 2026 player-centric ball-action spotting challenge extends FOOTPASS baselines with gradient checkpointing, GNN-DST fusion, class reweighting, and post-processing. It addresses extreme class imbalance and joint who-what-when prediction in broadcast soccer.

entry.title: Frankenstein in the Pipeline: Computational Epistemicide in Facial Recognition

author.name: Nina da Hora

entry.summary: This critical-studies paper uses Frankenstein as a diagnostic framework to argue that embedding-based facial recognition enacts computational epistemicide by reducing the face to a numerical proxy. It analyzes operational pipeline mechanisms rather than abstract metaphor.

entry.title: Hybrid Metaheuristic Combining the Dragonfly Algorithm and Tabu Search for the Traveling Salesman Problem

author.name: Ammar Bouketta

entry.summary: This paper proposes a hybrid metaheuristic combining the Dragonfly Algorithm for global exploration with Tabu Search for local refinement in a relay scheme for the Traveling Salesman Problem, evaluated on TSPLIB benchmarks. It follows high-level relay hybridization.

entry.title: Astro, I'm Home! Investigating Factors that Influence the Acceptance of Home Robots Using Supervised Machine Learning

author.name: Katrin Fischer, Essence Wilson, Steffie Kim, Dmitri Williams

entry.summary: This exploratory study applies regularization-based supervised machine learning to identify factors influencing home robot acceptance, finding performance expectancy, social influence, and hedonic motivation as strongest predictors within an extended UTAUT2 framework. Usability, trust, and competence also emerged as promising variables.

entry.title: MedicalRec: Medical recommender system for image classification without retraining

author.name: Roghayeh Taghavi, Aysa Hasanazde Bashkandi, Amir Ali Bengari, Mohammad Amin Raji, Mohammad Salahi Ardekani, Parisa Mardukhian, Parvaneh Rezaei, Ramin Mousa

entry.summary: Develops MedicalRec, a recommender system that suggests the optimal model for medical image classification without retraining, built from a dataset mined from 3,000 medical articles. Aims to reduce energy waste from trial-and-error model selection.

entry.title: Emergence via Phase Transitions: Mechanism Landscapes and Universal Convergence Across Complex Systems

author.name: Truong Xuan Khanh

entry.summary: Proposes the Hierarchical Emergence Framework, modeling emergence as a phase transition in a mechanism landscape governed by thermodynamic and information-theoretic laws, as a candidate universality theory spanning ML grokking, biology, and physics. Posits a critical energy threshold separating exploration and convergence regimes.

entry.title: Extending Ontologies: From Dense Embeddings to Hybrid Quantum-Fuzzy Systems

author.name: Angjelin Hila

entry.summary: This survey reviews integrations of ontologies and knowledge graphs with dense embeddings and proposes neuro-quantum-fuzzy systems using quantum-neural networks to simultaneously support probabilistic and crisp inference. It offers a speculative frontier for hybrid knowledge representation.

entry.title: XAInomaly: Explainable and Interpretable Deep Contractive Autoencoder for O-RAN Traffic Anomaly Detection

author.name: Osman Tugay Basaran, Falko Dressler

entry.summary: XAInomaly presents an explainable deep contractive autoencoder for anomaly detection in O-RAN network traffic, emphasizing interpretability alongside accuracy and reduced complexity for the disaggregated, multi-vendor O-RAN architecture. It targets traffic analysis, forecasting, and anomaly detection in next-generation wireless.

entry.title: Evaluating Hallucinations in Domain-Adapted Large Language Models

author.name: Sanchita Porwal, Sai Prasath S, Xingjian Bi, Madelyn Scandlen

entry.summary: Investigates hallucinations in domain-adapted LLMs by fine-tuning Llama-2 on the Lamini dataset, testing memorization, recall, and reasoning. Finds the model performs well on tasks similar to training data but struggles to reason about new domain-specific information.

entry.title: Concerns and Strategic Responses of Older Workers Navigating Generative AI in Bridge Employment

author.name: Aditya Nayak, Aakash Gautam, Rama Adithya Varanasi

entry.summary: A qualitative interview study of 21 older workers navigating generative AI disruptions during bridge employment before retirement, examining their concerns and strategic boundary-work responses. Highlights equity impacts of GenAI on vulnerable workers.

entry.title: Page image classifier fine-tuned on century-spanning archives of scanned documents for further content-specific processing

author.name: Kateryna Lutsai, Pavel Stra\v{n}\'ak, David Nov\'ak, Dana K\v{r}iv\'ankov\'a

entry.summary: Develops a page-image classifier fine-tuned on over 48,000 annotated century-old Czech archival pages to sort content into text, tables, and graphics for downstream OCR and extraction. Supports large-scale humanities digitization pipelines.

entry.title: A Hierarchical Feature Engineering Framework for Automated Classification of Phonotraumatic and Non-Phonotraumatic Vocal Hyperfunction

author.name: June-Woo Kim, Kangwook Jang, Minu Kim, Hyunju Lee

entry.summary: A hierarchical feature engineering framework classifies phonotraumatic versus non-phonotraumatic vocal hyperfunction from neck-surface acceleration signals, finding source-filter coupling features critical for both subtypes. It achieves an AUC of 0.891 for the phonotraumatic task.

entry.title: Test-Time Adaptive Composition for Machine Learning as a Service (MLaaS) in IoT Environments

author.name: Deepak Kanneganti, Sajib Mistry, Sheik Mohammad Mostakim Fattah, Aneesh Krishna

entry.summary: This paper proposes a test-time adaptive composition framework for Machine Learning as a Service in dynamic IoT environments, adjusting individual services at inference rather than replacing or re-composing them. It includes a composability model to verify continued compatibility.

entry.title: Does Persona Make LLMs K-pop Fans? A Pilot Study of LLM-Based Online Concert Audience Agents

author.name: Kirak Kim, Hyojin Kim, Yejin Son, Sungyoung Kim, Kyung Myun Lee

entry.summary: This pilot study tests whether persona-conditioned LLM audience agents can recreate the collective concert experience by generating real-time fan chat alongside a K-pop performance video. Persona conditioning improved chat naturalness but did not significantly translate to better viewer experience in a small within-subjects study.

entry.title: 3D Oral Modelling with Improved Vertex Distribution Using Matching-Based Learning

author.name: Jihun Cho, Soo-Yeon Jeong, Eun-Jeong Bae, Sun-Young Ihm

entry.summary: This work improves a deep learning framework for 3D intraoral reconstruction from fixed-angle images by adding Hungarian matching with filtering and a repulsion loss to enforce more uniform vertex distribution. It addresses clustering of predicted vertices in high-density ground-truth regions.

entry.title: Repair Before Veto, When Repair Is Hidden: Quantum-Accessible Features for Repair-Augmented Constraint Learning

author.name: Yifan Wang

entry.summary: Q-RACL introduces a repair-before-veto framework for hard-constraint decision systems that accepts infeasible candidates if an affordable repair plan restores feasibility, identifying where quantum feature access could aid repair-feasibility inference. It returns structured rejection credit when no repair works.

entry.title: Reconstructing Synthetic SDO/AIA 193 A EUV Images from He I 10830 A Observations with Diffusion Model Translator

author.name: Marco Marena, Qin Li, Haimin Wang, Haodi Jiang, Prajwal Shah, Bo Shen

entry.summary: Proposes a coronal-hole-aware diffusion model to translate He I 10830 observations into synthetic SDO/AIA 193 EUV images, enabling extension of EUV coronal context to pre-satellite eras. The approach uses temporally co-aligned solar observation pairs for conditional image translation.

entry.title: Few-shot Class-variable Incremental Audio Classification via Prototype Adaptation and Pseudo Class-variable Training

author.name: Yanxiong Li, Guoqing Chen, Qianqian Li, Sen Huang

entry.summary: Studies few-shot class-variable incremental audio classification where class counts can both increase and decrease, proposing prototype adaptation and pseudo class-variable training. The classifier dynamically restructures with changing classes.

entry.title: Real-time body pose non-verbal communication with a consistency-based reliability measure

author.name: Alina Marcu, Dragos Costea, Cristina Lazar, Marius Leordeanu

entry.summary: Studies recognition of communicative intent from 2D body pose alone for real-time low-cost human-to-robot communication in long-distance settings like rescue missions. Releases a dataset of ten communicative intents with a consistency-based reliability measure.

entry.title: Layer-wise Derivative Controlled Networks Achieve Competitive Accuracy and Gradient Stability Across Data Regimes

author.name: Rowan Martnishn

entry.summary: Evaluates ChainzRule derivative-controlled networks combining cubic polynomial layers with a Jacobian regularizer (DREG) across data regimes. It reports stable gradients and competitive low-data accuracy versus ReLU baselines on small datasets.

entry.title: Have I Solved This Before? Retrieving Similar Segmentation Problems for Evolutionary Learning

author.name: Andreas Margraf, Henning Cui, J\"org H\"ahner

entry.summary: Proposes shifting industrial image-segmentation system design from algorithm design to abstract problem modeling, storing solved-problem knowledge to retrieve similar past solutions for evolutionary learning. It aims to reuse knowledge across manufacturing inspection use cases.

entry.title: PROBE-Web: An Interactive System for Probing Evaluation Landscapes of Knowledge Graph Completion Models

author.name: Sooho Moon, Yunyong Ko

entry.summary: PROBE-Web is an interactive demo system implementing the PROBE evaluation framework for knowledge graph completion, letting users explore predictive sharpness and bias robustness via a GUI. A companion tool to the PROBE paper. Primarily a usability/demonstration contribution.

entry.title: Orange Lab: Lowering Barriers to Data Mining through Embedded Interactive Workflows

author.name: Matej Bevec, Ale\v{s} Erjavec, Vesna Tanko, Lena Trnovec, Lan \v{Z}agar, Ana Fari\v{c}, Janez Dem\v{s}ar, Bla\v{z} Zupan

entry.summary: Presents Orange Lab, a web-based collaborative environment for visual data analytics that embeds interactive, reactive machine learning workflows into web tools to democratize data science. Primarily a tooling and usability contribution. Matters for accessible data mining.

entry.title: Forecasting Japanese elections: A nonlinear machine-learning approach

author.name: Sota Kato, Xuan Luo, Budrul Ahsan, Asahi Obata, Takafumi Nakanishi

entry.summary: Introduces nonlinear machine-learning (decision tree and ensemble) forecasting models for Japanese lower-house elections, showing modest but consistent accuracy gains over a foundational statistical baseline. Applied political forecasting contribution. Domain-specific.

entry.title: Balancing Real and Synthetic Data for CNN-based Masonry Crack Detection

author.name: Mattia Forlesi, Alfonso Esposito, Ivan Zyrianoff, Alessandro Marzani, Marco Di Felice

entry.summary: Investigates balancing real and synthetic data for CNN-based masonry crack detection, generating synthetic crack images to supplement scarce real data for structural health monitoring. Studies the optimal real-to-synthetic mix for training effectiveness.

entry.title: Multi-View Speech Representation Learning for Parkinson's Disease Detection Using Context-guided Cross-modal Attention

author.name: George Theodosiou, Loukas Ilias, Dimitris Askounis

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-branch deep learning framework that fuses multiple speech representations using context-guided cross-modal attention for Parkinson's disease detection from voice recordings. Aims to capture complementary pathological cues missed by single-representation methods.

entry.title: TextEconomizer: Enhancing Lossy Text Compression with Denoising Transformers and Entropy Coding

author.name: Mahbub E Sobhani, Anika Tasnim Rodela, Chowdhury Mofizur Rahman, Dewan Md. Farid, Swakkhar Shatabda

entry.summary: Introduces TextEconomizer, an encoder-decoder framework combining denoising transformers with entropy coding for lossy text compression, reducing input size 50-80% while preserving meaning. Explores underused integration of context vectors and entropy coding in Seq2Seq generation.

entry.title: Benchmarking Quantum Algorithmic Resilience for CVaR Portfolio Optimization: The Expressibility-Coherence Trade-off

author.name: Prashik N. Somkuwar, K. Srinivasan, G. Raghavan

entry.summary: Benchmarks quantum algorithmic resilience for CVaR portfolio optimization, comparing a hardware-efficient variational quantum neural network with warm-start QAOA on an IBM heavy-hex processor for up to 16 NIFTY 50 assets. It introduces a hybrid proxy matrix to bypass the CVaR auxiliary qubit bottleneck.

entry.title: RPO-PDT: Demonstrating Role-Play-Based Knowledge Adaptation for Student Support Dialogue (Demonstration System)

author.name: Filip Janik, Ewa Olton, Robert Smales, Harris Spratt, Shea Tait, Md Zia Ullah, Yanchao Yu

entry.summary: RPO-PDT is a demonstration system for retrieval-grounded role-play dialogue providing adaptive student support in higher education, constrained by persona and safety policies with a reverse-roleplay loop that replays unresolved interactions to generate reusable strategy memory. It supports text and embodied Furhat interaction.

entry.title: Modeling Components and Connections in Cyber-Physical Systems

author.name: Kate Sanborn, Tanuj Kenchannavar, Vakul Nath, Jonathan Sprinkle

entry.summary: ROSLaunchVisual is a model-integrated environment built on WebGME for designing, visualizing, and managing ROS launch files, raising abstraction by representing nodes, publishers, subscribers, and arguments as interconnected graphical components. It exposes connection details often hidden in text-based configuration.

entry.title: Bidirectional Small-Granularity Search between Code and Text

author.name: Marco A. Valenzuela-Esc\'arcega, Enrique Noriega-Atala, Gus Hahn-Powell, Clayton T. Morrison, Mihai Surdeanu

entry.summary: This work introduces a blockchain-infrastructure tutorial for intelligent cyber-physical-social systems in the era of embodied AI, covering post-quantum security, interoperability, and trustworthy data economies for world-model-based robotics. It positions blockchain as a crypto-agile coordination layer amid quantum threats.

entry.title: AI-Integrated Learning Management System for Middle School: A Longitudinal Study of Learning Outcomes Through High School and Beyond

author.name: Misan Paul Etchie, Taiwo Olutosin

entry.summary: Describes an AI-integrated learning management system for middle school with a longitudinal study tracking learning outcomes into high school. Aims to provide timely instructional support rather than mere workflow tooling.

entry.title: Customer Churn Prediction on Structured Data Using FT-Transformer and Stacking Ensembles

author.name: Joyjit Roy, Samaresh Kumar Singh, Laxmi Shaw

entry.summary: Introduces a hybrid customer-churn prediction architecture integrating FT-Transformer with gradient-boosted trees via calibration-aware stacking on structured tabular data. Addresses class imbalance and nonlinear feature interactions.

entry.title: Harness Engineering for Physical AI: Robot Middleware Is the Harness Layer

author.name: Sanghoon Lee, Jiyeong Chae, Kyung-Joon Park

entry.summary: Examines practical challenges in operationalizing UK Defence's JSP 936 directive for AI assurance, identifying eight thematic challenge areas through a structured interpretive review. It argues the directive provides a governance basis but leaves key technical and organizational questions unresolved.

entry.title: Public Machine Learning Solver Framework for Novices in the Machine Learning Domain

author.name: Lokman Saleh, Hafedh Mili, Mounir Boukadoum

entry.summary: Proposes a platform combining expert cheat sheets and decision-support criteria to recommend complete ML pipelines (not single algorithms) for non-experts, integrating transfer learning. It aims to make ML problem-solving accessible to novices.

entry.title: From Architecture to Output: Structural Origins of Hallucination in Large Language Models and the Amplifying Role of Data

author.name: Md. Rejaul Korim Sadi, Toufiqur Rahman Tasin, Golam Mostofa Naeem

entry.summary: Analyzes LLM hallucination as a structural consequence of three architectural choices (self-attention co-occurrence, max-likelihood training, autoregression) rather than just an output taxonomy. Frames hallucination as a compound failure system amplified by data.

entry.title: Symbolic Reasoning Frameworks Modulate LLM Risk Aversion in Multi-Agent Strategic Settings

author.name: Augustin Chan

entry.summary: Shows that injecting symbolic reasoning frameworks (I-Ching, Tarot) as reflective prompts modulates LLMs' risk-averse bias in a multi-agent Diplomacy variant, producing framework-specific winner distributions. Explores how reasoning scaffolds reshape strategic agent behavior.

entry.title: Seq103: A Unified Neuroevolution Framework for Compact Sequence Architecture Discovery

author.name: Wenxiao Li, Yongjian Liu, Qing Xie

entry.summary: Seq103 is a NEAT-style neuroevolution framework for discovering compact sequence architectures, combining an evolutionary backbone with an optional recurrent hidden-state extension for temporal memory. It aims to evolve both topology and weights for small sequence models.

entry.title: SEF-CLGC at SemEval-2026 Task 11: Logical Notation Impact on Language Model Performance

author.name: Hanna Abi Akl, Fabien Gandon, Catherine Faron, Pierre Monnin

entry.summary: Combines formal logical notations with small language models to evaluate reasoning while reducing content bias on a SemEval syllogistic reasoning subtask. Reports modest content scores with significantly lowered content bias using natural plus symbolic training.

entry.title: Zero-Shot Semantic Re-Identification for Autonomous Driving: A VLM Baseline Study

author.name: Eduardo Borges, Manuel Abreu, Lu\'is Garrote, Urbano J. Nunes

entry.summary: Studies a zero-shot ReID pipeline for autonomous driving where VLMs generate textual descriptions of traffic participants to support identity matching across frames. A baseline exploration of language-grounded interpretable re-identification.

entry.title: Accelerated Skill Learning via Dream Engineering and Biofeedback

author.name: Elliot Callender

entry.summary: This post explores dream engineering and targeted memory reactivation, citing experiments where sound cues during sleep biased dream content, and speculates how direct neural stimulation could vastly expand the degrees of freedom for accelerated skill learning. It connects engram consolidation to potential learning enhancement.

entry.title: Beyond Humans: Multispecies Animal Face Recognition Using Transfer Learning

author.name: Maria De Marsico, Anil K. Jain, Annalaura Miglino

entry.summary: Applies transfer learning to multispecies animal face recognition for tracking pets, endangered species, and farm animals as a non-invasive alternative to microchips. It addresses limited per-subject annotated data across species.

entry.title: A Resilience-as-a-Service assessment framework for coordinated disruption response in interdependent urban transit systems

author.name: Sara Jaber, S. M. Hassan Mahdavi, Neila Bhouri, Mostafa Ameli

entry.summary: This paper proposes a KPI-driven, time-indexed resilience assessment framework for urban transit disruption response, combining optimization with agent-based behavioral simulation. It uniquely accounts for secondary degradation on helper lines.

entry.title: Considerations for an Integrated Detector Design at FCC-ee: A Human-AI Exploration

author.name: Charles Young

entry.summary: A report documenting a human-AI dialogue exploring integrated detector design considerations for the proposed FCC-ee collider, with an AI assistant proposing concepts later challenged and refined by a physicist. Demonstrates AI as a brainstorming collaborator in experimental physics design.

entry.title: MIRAGE: Metadata-Integrated Repository Analysis and Guided Enhancement for MSR Datasets

author.name: Aabia Ather, Muhammad Usayd Ather, Qurat-Ul-Ain Somroo, Muhammad Khuram Shahzad

entry.summary: Proposes MIRAGE, an approach for analyzing Mining Software Repositories datasets via metadata enrichment, FAIRness assessment, and LDA topic-driven analysis across 2013-2024 papers. Adds annotations and filtering to an existing dataset directory.

entry.title: Governance Controls for AI-Generated Test Artifacts in Autonomous Software Testing

author.name: Dimple Bajaj, Deepak Khetan

entry.summary: Introduces a Governance-Aware Autonomous Testing Framework adding governance validation, explainability, risk assessment, and compliance monitoring to AI-generated test artifacts. Evaluated on Defects4J and PROMISE datasets.

entry.title: I Was Scrolling and Then I Saw a Pregnant Strawberry

author.name: Piera Riccio

entry.summary: Critically analyzes AI minidramas (fruit dramas) - short generative AI video series - arguing they reproduce gendered narrative structures and encode racialization logic. It draws on feminist film theory, critical race theory, and platform studies.

entry.title: Orthogonality and Dimensionality in Airline Cluster Analysis using PCA and Kernel PCA

author.name: Andreas Schlapbach

entry.summary: Replicates a prior airline profit-cycle clustering study across raw, 3-PC, and 4-PC spaces and applies kernel PCA with six kernels, showing the six-cluster taxonomy is geometrically robust and dimension-reduction-invariant. It validates clustering stability under linear and nonlinear projections.

entry.title: Automating the Expert Eye: A System-Agnostic Deep Learning Framework for Rare Event Discovery in Imbalanced Force Spectroscopy

author.name: Jorge Rodriguez-Ramos

entry.summary: Presents a system-agnostic deep learning framework using rasterized geometric matrices and a focal-loss ResNet18 to detect rare unbinding events in highly imbalanced single-molecule force spectroscopy data. Automates a manual curation bottleneck in biophysics.

entry.title: QDS-SNN: Energy-efficient Quantum Deeply-Supervised Spiking Neural Network Algorithm for Traffic Sign Recognition

author.name: Zhiguo Qu, Keqi Li, Le Sun, Wenjie Liu, Yimin Yu, Saif Al-Kuwari, Ahmed Farouk

entry.summary: Combines quantum neural networks with deeply-supervised spiking neural networks for energy-efficient traffic sign recognition. Uses quantum superposition and entanglement to mitigate information loss and vanishing gradients in SNN training.

entry.title: BLM-SGAN: Bidirectional Language Modeling for Semantic-Spatial Text-to-Image Generation

author.name: Ahmed Abdelmoneim Mazrou, Haidy Maher El-Amir, Ali Hamdi

entry.summary: BLM-SGAN introduces bidirectional language modeling into a GAN-based text-to-image model to better capture long-range dependencies and semantic-spatial relationships. Targets limitations of sequential processing in GAN T2I synthesis.

entry.title: Trustworthy Smart Fabs via Professional Proxies: Scaling Safe and Sustainable by Design (SSbD) through Industrial Data Spaces

author.name: Han-Teng Liao, Chang-Yi Kao, Karen Ang

entry.summary: Proposes a zero-trust socio-technical orchestration framework operationalizing a six-layer Safe and Sustainable by Design reference architecture within industrial data spaces for semiconductor smart fabs. Aims to reconcile regulatory transparency with corporate data privacy under EU SSbD, CSDDD, and CBAM.

entry.title: Proposal Refinement for Few-Shot Object Detection

author.name: Yuan Zeng, Bin Song, Jie Guo, Yuwen Chen

entry.summary: Proposes a proposal refinement approach for few-shot object detection that addresses unbalanced region proposal distribution between novel and base classes via a refinement loss and an auxiliary RPN branch. It aims to improve detection of rare classes without relying solely on few-shot classification performance.

author.name: Ramseyian
